capabilities.name: Google advertising ID (AAID/GAID)
capabilities.plain: A resettable Google ID apps use for ads, which the person can delete, giving apps zeros.
capabilities.headline: Can use a resettable Google ad ID to link your activity across apps

capabilities.name: AdAttributionKit re-engagement conversions
capabilities.plain: Measures whether an ad brought an existing user back into the app.
capabilities.headline: Can count whether an ad brought you back to an app you already have, on iPhone

capabilities.name: AdAttributionKit (iOS 17.4)
capabilities.plain: Apple's successor to SKAdNetwork that also covers re-engagement and alternative app stores.
capabilities.headline: Can tell an ad network an ad led to an install, on iPhone, with delays

capabilities.name: In-app consent platforms (TCF/CMP)
capabilities.plain: A consent screen the developer shows (in addition to the OS prompt) for EEA, UK and some US laws.
capabilities.headline: Can show an extra consent screen on top of the phone prompt

capabilities.name: Meta (Facebook) SDK and app events
capabilities.plain: Meta's SDK logs installs and in-app events and can send hashed email or phone to match people.
capabilities.headline: Can send your app activity to Meta and match it to your account

capabilities.name: Fingerprinting ban and ATT enforcement
capabilities.plain: Apple forbids deriving a device identity from signals to track someone who said no under ATT.
capabilities.headline: Can't rebuild your identity from phone details after you refuse tracking on iPhone

capabilities.name: Google Analytics for Firebase
capabilities.plain: Google's free analytics SDK that gives every install an ID and logs automatic events.
capabilities.headline: Can give each install an ID and log your taps and screens for Google

capabilities.name: Google Ads app campaign measurement
capabilities.plain: Google Play services and the Firebase SDK report installs and in-app events straight to Google Ads.
capabilities.headline: Can tell Google Ads about your installs and in app actions

capabilities.name: IDFA (Identifier for Advertisers)
capabilities.plain: A resettable device ad ID that apps can read only if the person allowed tracking.
capabilities.headline: Can use your iPhone ad ID only if you tap Allow on the tracking prompt

capabilities.name: IDFV and App Set ID (developer-scoped IDs)
capabilities.plain: A per-developer app ID that needs no prompt but cannot cross to other companies' apps.
capabilities.headline: Can recognise your phone across one company's apps, but not other companies' apps

capabilities.name: Adjust SDK
capabilities.plain: A third-party SDK for install attribution, SKAN management, deep links and fraud filtering.
capabilities.headline: Can link your install to its ad and watch what you do in the app

capabilities.name: AppsFlyer SDK
capabilities.plain: A third-party SDK that attributes installs, runs deep links, and sends events to ad networks.
capabilities.headline: Can link your install to an ad and watch what you do in the app

capabilities.name: Branch SDK
capabilities.plain: A SDK known for deferred deep links that also does attribution and clipboard-based matching.
capabilities.headline: Can open the right screen after install and link the install to an ad

capabilities.name: Singular SDK
capabilities.plain: A SDK that attributes installs and also merges ad spend and SKAN data into one ROI view.
capabilities.headline: Can link your install to an ad and show spending and results in one place

capabilities.name: Private Click Measurement (Safari to app)
capabilities.plain: Safari can report that an ad click on a web page led to an app install or purchase, without IDs.
capabilities.headline: Can tell a site an ad click led to an install, without a device ID

capabilities.name: Attribution Reporting API on Android
capabilities.plain: A built-in way for ad tech to count conversions with noise and limits, without ad IDs.
capabilities.headline: Can't count on this Android ad counting tool, since Google announced it is retiring it

capabilities.name: Protected Audience on Android (FLEDGE)
capabilities.plain: On-device ad auctions for remarketing, without sending a person's history to ad servers.
capabilities.headline: Can't count on Android ad auctions on your phone, since Google is retiring them

capabilities.name: Third-party SDK data sharing
capabilities.plain: Any SDK in an app can read what the app can read and send it to its own servers.
capabilities.headline: Can share anything the app can see with its add on tools, who send it on

capabilities.name: SDK Runtime (privacy sandbox)
capabilities.plain: Would have run ad SDKs in their own process so they could not read the host app's data.
capabilities.headline: Can't run ad tools in a separate box on Android, since Google retired it

capabilities.name: Server-side conversions APIs
capabilities.plain: The advertiser's server sends purchase or signup events to ad platforms, with hashed email or phone.
capabilities.headline: Can send your purchases and signups from its server to ad platforms

capabilities.name: SKAdNetwork 4 (postbacks)
capabilities.plain: Apple sends the ad network a signed, delayed, anonymized report that an ad led to an install.
capabilities.headline: Can tell an ad network an ad led to an install, in a delayed report

capabilities.name: SKAN conversion values (fine and coarse)
capabilities.plain: A 6-bit number the app sets after install so the ad network learns how valuable the user was.
capabilities.headline: Can send the ad network a small score about what you did after install

capabilities.name: SKAN crowd anonymity tiers
capabilities.plain: Apple withholds detail from postbacks when too few installs came from a campaign.
capabilities.headline: Can't get much detail when too few people installed from an ad

capabilities.name: SKAN postback windows and timers
capabilities.plain: Postbacks arrive days after install, in three time windows with random delays.
capabilities.headline: Can only get install reports days later, in three windows with random delays

capabilities.name: Topics API on Android
capabilities.plain: Android would have told ad SDKs a few interest topics from the person's recent app use.
capabilities.headline: Can't tell ad tools your interest topics on Android, since Google retired it

capabilities.name: Uninstall tracking via push
capabilities.plain: Apps or MMPs detect an uninstall by noticing a push token has stopped working.
capabilities.headline: Can tell when you delete the app by noticing that its push messages fail

capabilities.name: Image generation (Image Playground)
capabilities.plain: Creates stylised images on device from prompts.
capabilities.headline: Can offer picture creation through Apple's Image Playground sheet, and sees only the result

capabilities.name: On-device language model (Foundation Models, Gemini Nano Prompt API)
capabilities.plain: Runs a small language model on the phone with no cloud call.
capabilities.headline: Can use a small AI model on your phone, with no internet needed

capabilities.name: On-device ML runtime (Core ML, LiteRT)
capabilities.plain: Runs trained models on the phone's neural hardware.
capabilities.headline: Can run trained AI models on your phone's own chip

capabilities.name: Assistant screen context
capabilities.plain: Lets the assistant see what is on screen to answer questions.
capabilities.headline: Can see your screen when you call the assistant, if it is your chosen one

capabilities.name: System writing tools (Writing Tools, ML Kit Summarization and Rewriting)
capabilities.plain: Offers rewrite, proofread and summarise inside any text field.
capabilities.headline: Can offer rewrite, proofread and summarize inside text boxes, if Apple Intelligence is on

capabilities.name: On-device translation
capabilities.plain: Translates text on the phone.
capabilities.headline: Can translate text on your phone, after you download a language pack

capabilities.name: Text recognition and visual look up (Live Text, Visual Look Up, ML Kit)
capabilities.plain: Reads text in images and scans documents on device.
capabilities.headline: Can pick out text in pictures and scan documents on your phone

capabilities.name: In-app browser
capabilities.plain: Opens outside links in a browser inside the app.
capabilities.headline: Can show web pages inside the app and, in some versions, watch what you do

capabilities.name: Linking an app to a website
capabilities.plain: Proves the app and website are owned together, enabling app links and shared passwords.
capabilities.headline: Can open web links in the app and offer saved passwords once linked

capabilities.name: In-car apps (CarPlay and Android Auto)
capabilities.plain: Shows an app on the car dashboard within strict templates.
capabilities.headline: Can show the app on your car screen, but only in a few fixed layouts

capabilities.name: Home accessories (HomeKit and Matter)
capabilities.plain: Reads and controls the person's smart home: lights, locks, cameras.
capabilities.headline: Can see and control your smart home devices, only after you allow it

capabilities.name: Purpose strings and review rejection
capabilities.plain: Every iOS privacy prompt needs a written reason in the app, or the app is rejected or crashes.
capabilities.headline: Can't ask for iPhone access without a written reason shown in the prompt

capabilities.name: Siri and voice shortcuts
capabilities.plain: Lets Siri send the app voice requests and read the app's shortcuts.
capabilities.headline: Can accept your Siri voice requests and show shortcuts, after you allow Siri

capabilities.name: Usage access
capabilities.plain: Lets the app see which apps are used and for how long.
capabilities.headline: Can see which apps you open and for how long, after you switch it on

capabilities.name: Install referrer
capabilities.plain: The Play Store hands the app the campaign link that led to its install, readable for 90 days.
capabilities.headline: Can learn which ad or link led to your install, for 90 days after

capabilities.name: SKAdNetwork and AdAttributionKit
capabilities.plain: Apple's privacy preserving attribution: ad networks learn campaign results from a delayed, noisy postback.
capabilities.headline: Can tell an ad network an ad led to an install, in a delayed report

capabilities.name: App Tracking Transparency
capabilities.plain: A system prompt that asks whether the app may track the person across other companies' apps and sites.
capabilities.headline: Can track you across other companies' apps and sites only if you tap Allow

capabilities.name: Background audio and media playback
capabilities.plain: Apps can keep playing sound with the screen off; Android 17 adds new limits for apps that target it.
capabilities.headline: Can keep playing sound with the screen off, with new limits in Android 17

capabilities.name: Background downloads and uploads
capabilities.plain: A system service finishes downloads and uploads for the app even after it is closed.
capabilities.headline: Can finish downloads and uploads for the app even after you close it

capabilities.name: Bluetooth Low Energy in the background
capabilities.plain: Apps can keep talking to Bluetooth devices when closed, with strict scan rules on iOS.
capabilities.headline: Can keep talking to Bluetooth gadgets with the app closed, with strict scan rules

capabilities.name: Doze and idle mode
capabilities.plain: When the phone is still and unplugged, Android delays jobs, alarms and network to save battery.
capabilities.headline: Can't force the phone to stay awake; Doze delays jobs, alarms and network

capabilities.name: Why the process ended (exit reasons)
capabilities.plain: Apps can read why they were killed: Android ApplicationExitInfo, iOS MetricKit exit metrics.
capabilities.headline: Can learn why the system last ended the app, such as low memory

capabilities.name: Expedited and user-initiated long jobs
capabilities.plain: Jobs that start soon or run long after a user action: Android expedited and UIDT, iOS 26 continued processing.
capabilities.headline: Can run jobs soon or for a long time after you tap something, with daily limits

capabilities.name: Background start restrictions
capabilities.plain: Apps in the background cannot freely start foreground services or open screens.
capabilities.headline: Can't freely start work or open screens from the background

capabilities.name: Foreground service timeouts (Android 15)
capabilities.plain: Some foreground services now stop after 6 hours in 24, and can only restart after a user returns to the app.
capabilities.headline: Can keep some Android services running, but only about 6 hours in 24

capabilities.name: Foreground service types (Android 14)
capabilities.plain: Every foreground service must declare a purpose and hold the matching permission.
capabilities.headline: Can run long Android background tasks, but only for a declared purpose with a notification

capabilities.name: Force stop and force quit
capabilities.plain: A person can kill an app: Android force stop cancels alarms; iOS force quit stops background fetch and silent push.
capabilities.headline: Can't keep running or wake itself after you force stop (Android) or swipe it away (iPhone)

capabilities.name: iOS background modes
capabilities.plain: Xcode background modes (audio, location, VoIP, Bluetooth, fetch, push) decide what can run while closed.
capabilities.headline: Can run in the background on iPhone, but only for the kind of job Apple approved

capabilities.name: iOS app refresh and processing tasks
capabilities.plain: iOS lets apps request short refreshes (about 30 s) or longer idle processing; timing is up to the system.
capabilities.headline: Can ask iPhone for short refreshes of about 30 seconds, but the system picks the time

capabilities.name: Low Power Mode, Battery Saver and Background App Refresh state
capabilities.plain: Apps can see whether the phone is in a power saving state and adapt, and iOS shows if background refresh is on.
capabilities.headline: Can see if your phone is saving power, and slow itself down to match

capabilities.name: OEM background killers
capabilities.plain: Many Android makers add extra killers that stop apps beyond what Google's rules allow.
capabilities.headline: Can't count on running in the background on some Android phones, since brands add extra killers

capabilities.name: Region monitoring and geofences
capabilities.plain: Wakes the app when the device enters or leaves a circle: 20 regions on iOS, 100 geofences on Android.
capabilities.headline: Can wake the app when you enter or leave set places, up to 20 on iPhone

capabilities.name: Restricted bucket and battery restriction settings
capabilities.plain: The user can set an app to Unrestricted, Optimized or Restricted; unused apps can fall into Restricted.
capabilities.headline: Can only run in the background as much as your battery setting allows

capabilities.name: Significant location change
capabilities.plain: A low power way to learn that the device moved a long distance, even when the app is closed.
capabilities.headline: Can learn that you moved a long way, about 500 meters, even with the app closed

capabilities.name: App Standby Buckets
capabilities.plain: Android sorts apps into five buckets that cap job time, alarms and network by how recently they were used.
capabilities.headline: Can't run as much in the background if you rarely open the app

capabilities.name: Visit monitoring
capabilities.plain: iOS reports the places a person stays at (arrival and departure) without constant GPS.
capabilities.headline: Can learn which places you stay at, with arrival and leave times, on iPhone

capabilities.name: Deferrable background work (WorkManager, JobScheduler)
capabilities.plain: The standard way to run background tasks; periodic work cannot repeat faster than every 15 minutes.
capabilities.headline: Can run background jobs on Android, but not more often than every 15 minutes

capabilities.name: Camera
capabilities.plain: Asks to use the camera for photos, video, scanning or video calls.
capabilities.headline: Can use your camera while the app is open, after you tap Allow

capabilities.name: Global camera and mic toggles
capabilities.plain: System switches that turn the camera or mic off for all apps.
capabilities.headline: Can show you a blank camera and silence when you flip a phone wide switch

capabilities.name: Camera and microphone indicators
capabilities.plain: A dot or chip that shows the camera or mic is active.
capabilities.headline: Can't use the camera or mic without a dot or chip showing

capabilities.name: Microphone
capabilities.plain: Asks to record sound from the microphone.
capabilities.headline: Can listen through your microphone while in use, after you tap Allow

capabilities.name: Recording indicator dot
capabilities.plain: A green or orange dot shows when an app is using the camera or microphone.
capabilities.headline: Can't use the camera or mic without a green or orange dot showing

capabilities.name: Speech recognition
capabilities.plain: Turns the person's speech or audio files into text, possibly on Apple servers.
capabilities.headline: Can turn your speech into text, sometimes on Apple's servers

capabilities.name: Device accounts list
capabilities.plain: Lets the app list the Google and other accounts signed in on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can list only its own accounts on Android; iPhone shows no account list

capabilities.name: Calendar
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read or write the user's calendar events.
capabilities.headline: Can see and add calendar events after you allow it, or only add them on iPhone

capabilities.name: Calendar, full access
capabilities.plain: Reads and edits every event in the person's calendars.
capabilities.headline: Can see, add and change every event in all your calendars once you allow full access

capabilities.name: Calendar, write only
capabilities.plain: Adds events to the calendar without reading anything already there.
capabilities.headline: Can add events to your calendar without seeing anything already in it

capabilities.name: Contacts, read and write
capabilities.plain: Reads the whole address book: names, numbers, emails, addresses.
capabilities.headline: Can open your whole address book once you allow it, or only some on iPhone

capabilities.name: Limited contacts access
capabilities.plain: The person lets the app see only chosen contacts, not the whole address book.
capabilities.headline: Can see only the contacts you choose on iPhone; Android gives only a one time pick

capabilities.name: Contact notes field
capabilities.plain: Apps cannot read free-text notes on contacts without an Apple entitlement.
capabilities.headline: Can't see the Notes field on contacts on iPhone without Apple's special approval

capabilities.name: Contact picker
capabilities.plain: A system screen where the person selects contacts to share; no permission needed.
capabilities.headline: Can get only the contacts and fields you pick in the system screen, no permission needed

capabilities.name: Read contacts
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read the whole address book.
capabilities.headline: Can see your whole address book once you tap Allow, or only some on iPhone

capabilities.name: Reminders
capabilities.plain: Reads and edits the Reminders app's lists.
capabilities.headline: Can see and change your Reminders lists on iPhone; Android has no shared list

capabilities.name: Write contacts
capabilities.plain: Lets the app add, edit or delete address book entries.
capabilities.headline: Can add, edit and delete address book entries once you tap Allow

capabilities.name: Adding contacts through the system editor
capabilities.plain: An app creates or edits a contact by opening the system editor, not by writing silently.
capabilities.headline: Can open the system contact screen so you add or edit a contact yourself

capabilities.name: Probing for specific installed apps
capabilities.plain: Android lets an app declare apps to see; iOS limits canOpenURL to 50 declared schemes.
capabilities.headline: Can check if a few named apps are installed, but not list them all

capabilities.name: Biometric availability and enrollment change
capabilities.plain: Reads if biometrics are enrolled; iOS also exposes a token that changes when enrollment changes.
capabilities.headline: Can check whether you set up fingerprint or face unlock, but not who you are

capabilities.name: Clipboard read
capabilities.plain: Android shows a toast on read; iOS 16 asks Allow Paste; reading the change count is silent.
capabilities.headline: Can see what you copied while the app is open, and you may get a notice

capabilities.name: Debugger, hooks and developer mode flags
capabilities.plain: Apps can read whether ADB, developer options or a debugger are on.
capabilities.headline: Can check if developer mode or a debugger is turned on, with no prompt on Android

capabilities.name: Emulator and simulator detection
capabilities.plain: Apps read build fields and hardware traits to spot emulators.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if the app is running on a fake phone used for testing

capabilities.name: Install source and installer package
capabilities.plain: Apps can see which store installed them.
capabilities.headline: Can see which store installed it, like Google Play or a side loaded file

capabilities.name: App install and update time
capabilities.plain: Android gives exact install and update timestamps; iOS gives them only indirectly.
capabilities.headline: Can see when it was installed and last updated, with exact times on Android

capabilities.name: Full installed-app list (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES)
capabilities.plain: Android can list every installed app only with a special permission Play restricts; iOS cannot at all.
capabilities.headline: Can't list every app on iPhone; on Android only with special store approval

capabilities.name: Device lock and passcode state
capabilities.plain: Reads whether the phone has a screen lock and whether it is locked.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if your phone has a screen lock and whether it is locked now

capabilities.name: Root and jailbreak detection
capabilities.plain: Apps infer root or jailbreak from files, props and attestation; neither OS gives a direct flag.
capabilities.headline: Can guess if your phone is rooted or jailbroken, but cannot be sure

capabilities.name: Screenshot and screen recording detection
capabilities.plain: Apps are told when the person takes a screenshot or records the screen.
capabilities.headline: Can tell when you take a screenshot or record the screen, but not stop you

capabilities.name: Battery health, temperature and cycle count
capabilities.plain: Android 14 lets apps read battery cycle count and health; iOS shows none of this to apps.
capabilities.headline: Can see battery health and charge cycles on Android 14 and newer, but not on iPhone

capabilities.name: Battery level and charging state
capabilities.plain: Reads battery percent and whether the phone is plugged in, with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see your battery percent and if the phone is charging, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Boot time and uptime
capabilities.plain: Reads time since boot; the boot timestamp itself is a classic stable ID until restart.
capabilities.headline: Can see how long your phone has been on, and on Android its restart count

capabilities.name: Screen brightness
capabilities.plain: Reads the screen brightness setting with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can check your screen brightness with no prompt, and change it while the app is open

capabilities.name: Build fingerprint and kernel version
capabilities.plain: Reads the full build ID string and kernel version.
capabilities.headline: Can see your exact phone software build, a long label often over 100 characters

capabilities.name: CPU cores and ABI
capabilities.plain: Reads core count and CPU architecture with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see how many CPU cores your phone has and what chip type, with no prompt

capabilities.name: User-assigned device name
capabilities.plain: Reads the name the person gave their phone: free on Android, locked to a generic name on iOS 16 and later.
capabilities.headline: Can see the name you gave your phone on Android, but a generic one on iPhone

capabilities.name: Low Power Mode and Battery Saver
capabilities.plain: Tells an app whether the person turned on the system power-saving mode.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if Battery Saver or Low Power Mode is on, but cannot change it

capabilities.name: Device model and manufacturer
capabilities.plain: Reads exact model and manufacturer on Android; iOS gives a model code via sysctl.
capabilities.headline: Can see your exact phone model and maker on Android, and a model code on iPhone

capabilities.name: OS version and security patch level
capabilities.plain: Reads OS version, API level and security patch date with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see your phone's system version and security patch date, with no prompt

capabilities.name: RAM size
capabilities.plain: Reads total memory in bytes with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see how much memory your phone has, down to the exact byte, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Display refresh rate and HDR
capabilities.plain: Reads the screen refresh rate and HDR support with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see your screen refresh rate and whether it shows HDR, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Ringer mode, Do Not Disturb and Focus
capabilities.plain: Android shows ringer mode and DND state freely; iOS exposes only a Focus on/off flag after a prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see ringer and Do Not Disturb on Android, but only Focus on iPhone

capabilities.name: Screen size and density
capabilities.plain: Reads pixel size, density and scale factor with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see your screen size, sharpness and scale, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Free and total storage
capabilities.plain: Reads exact free and total disk bytes with no prompt; on iOS this needs a declared reason.
capabilities.headline: Can see free and total storage on Android, and on iPhone only with a stated reason

capabilities.name: Thermal state and headroom
capabilities.plain: Reports how hot the device is: 4 coarse levels on iOS, 7 levels plus a forecast on Android.
capabilities.headline: Can tell how hot your phone is, in 4 levels on iPhone and 7 on Android

capabilities.name: Volume level per audio stream
capabilities.plain: Reads the current media, ring and alarm volume without any prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see how loud your phone is set, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Extended virtual addressing
capabilities.plain: Lets an app use a much larger virtual address space.
capabilities.headline: Can use a larger memory address range on iPhone, but not on Android

capabilities.name: App and device identifiers
capabilities.plain: IDs the OS gives an app to recognize an install or a vendor's apps.
capabilities.headline: Can use IDs your phone gives it to recognize this install or the developer's apps

capabilities.name: Increased memory limit
capabilities.plain: Raises the foreground memory cap for heavy apps.
capabilities.headline: Can ask for more working memory for heavy tasks, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Device name set by the person
capabilities.plain: Reads the name a person gave the phone, such as a first name plus a model.
capabilities.headline: Can see the name you gave your phone on Android, but a generic one on iPhone

capabilities.name: Draw over other apps
capabilities.plain: Lets the app draw windows on top of other apps.
capabilities.headline: Can draw windows over other apps on Android if you flip a switch, never on iPhone

capabilities.name: Picture in picture
capabilities.plain: Lets video keep playing in a small window while the user uses other apps.
capabilities.headline: Can keep a video playing in a small window while you use other apps

capabilities.name: Custom URL schemes and app discovery
capabilities.plain: A custom scheme (myapp://) opens an app; apps can probe which other apps are installed.
capabilities.headline: Can open another app by its link name and guess which apps you have

capabilities.name: Universal Links and Android App Links
capabilities.plain: Verified web links that open the app directly, proven by a file on the website.
capabilities.headline: Can open the app directly from a website link, with the full link and campaign tags

capabilities.name: Cache and temporary storage eviction
capabilities.plain: The system may delete cache and temporary files when storage runs low; other files stay.
capabilities.headline: Can store temporary files that the system may delete when your storage runs low

capabilities.name: File data protection classes
capabilities.plain: Files are encrypted at rest, and whether an app can read them while the phone is locked depends on a protection class.
capabilities.headline: Can keep files locked until you unlock the phone, depending on how they are protected

capabilities.name: Document picker
capabilities.plain: System file chooser for one document, such as a resume.
capabilities.headline: Can open one document you pick from the system file chooser

capabilities.name: All files access
capabilities.plain: Gives the app access to nearly all files on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can open almost every file on your Android phone if you turn on All files access

capabilities.name: Read audio files
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read music and audio files on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can list and play the music and audio files on your phone once you allow it

capabilities.name: Read photos
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read all photos in the shared gallery.
capabilities.headline: Can open all photos in your gallery, or only the ones you choose on newer phones

capabilities.name: Music and media library
capabilities.plain: Reads the person's own music library and listening history.
capabilities.headline: Can see your own music library and play your songs once you tap Allow

capabilities.name: Media location metadata
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read the GPS location stored inside photos.
capabilities.headline: Can see where your photos were taken, if you allow location info in media

capabilities.name: Selected photos access
capabilities.plain: Lets the user share only chosen photos and videos with the app.
capabilities.headline: Can open only the photos and videos you choose to share, not your whole library

capabilities.name: Read videos
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read all videos in the shared gallery.
capabilities.headline: Can open every video in your gallery on Android, and on iPhone with the photos permission

capabilities.name: Photo picker
capabilities.plain: A system gallery picker that returns only chosen photos with no permission.
capabilities.headline: Can open only the photos you pick from a system gallery, with no permission asked

capabilities.name: Photo library, add only
capabilities.plain: Saves a photo or video into the library without being able to read any of it.
capabilities.headline: Can save new photos and videos to your library, but cannot look at what is there

capabilities.name: Photo library, full access
capabilities.plain: Reads and edits every photo and video in the shared library.
capabilities.headline: Can see and change every photo and video in your library once you allow full access

capabilities.name: Limited photo access (chosen items only)
capabilities.plain: The person shares only hand-picked photos with the app, not the whole library.
capabilities.headline: Can see only the photos you hand pick, not your whole library

capabilities.name: Scoped storage and shared files
capabilities.plain: Android apps see their own folder and shared media through MediaStore; all files access needs a special grant.
capabilities.headline: Can open its own folder and shared media only, not everyone's files, on Android

capabilities.name: Legacy external storage
capabilities.plain: Old permission for reading and writing shared files.
capabilities.headline: Can't open shared files with the old storage permission on newer Android, and never on iPhone

capabilities.name: Body sensors
capabilities.plain: Asks to read heart rate and similar body sensor data while the app is in use.
capabilities.headline: Can see your heart rate and similar body signals while the app is open

capabilities.name: Body sensors in background
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read heart rate and similar vitals while not on screen.
capabilities.headline: Can keep checking your heart rate and vitals while the app is not on screen

capabilities.name: Clinical health records (FHIR)
capabilities.plain: Reads medical records such as conditions, allergies and immunizations in FHIR form.
capabilities.headline: Can see your medical records, such as conditions and allergies, if you share them

capabilities.name: Health Connect permissions
capabilities.plain: A set of per-data-type read and write permissions for the health data store.
capabilities.headline: Can see and add health data, one type at a time, from Health Connect or Health

capabilities.name: SensorKit research sensors
capabilities.plain: Reads broad passive sensor data for approved research studies only.
capabilities.headline: Can't collect broad sensor data like research studies do, unless Apple approves a study

capabilities.name: Accessory pairing without broad Bluetooth access

capabilities.name: Augmented reality world tracking

capabilities.headline: Can see through the camera and map your room while the app is open

capabilities.name: Bluetooth LE scan and connect

capabilities.headline: Can find and connect to nearby Bluetooth gadgets once you allow Bluetooth

capabilities.name: Bluetooth Classic (RFCOMM, A2DP, HID)

capabilities.headline: Can talk to headsets, printers and car kits on Android; iPhone allows only certified accessories

capabilities.name: Camera extensions and hardware camera controls

capabilities.headline: Can use phone camera modes such as night and HDR, after you allow the camera

capabilities.name: External display and casting output

capabilities.name: LiDAR and depth sensing

capabilities.name: Host card emulation (HCE)

capabilities.headline: Can act as a contactless card or key when you pick it as default

capabilities.name: Secure Element and NFC platform access
capabilities.plain: Reads and writes applets in the phone's secure chip for keys, badges and payments.
capabilities.headline: Can use the phone's secure chip only with special approval

capabilities.name: Flashlight (torch)
capabilities.plain: Turns the camera LED on as a flashlight.
capabilities.headline: Can turn the flashlight on while the app is open, with no permission

capabilities.name: USB host and accessories
capabilities.plain: Talks to USB devices plugged into the phone.
capabilities.headline: Can talk to plugged in USB gear on Android; iPhone mostly limits apps to certified devices

capabilities.name: Wear OS and watchOS companion apps
capabilities.plain: Pairs a watch app with the phone app and syncs data between them.
capabilities.headline: Can sync data between the phone app and watch app; sensors keep their own prompts

capabilities.name: AD_ID permission
capabilities.plain: Android 13 apps must declare AD_ID in the manifest to read the advertising ID.
capabilities.headline: Can use the Android ad ID only if the app lists the AD_ID permission

capabilities.name: Advertising ID (IDFA and AAID)
capabilities.plain: A resettable ad ID: Android gives it by default, iOS only after the person taps Allow in the ATT prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can use a resettable ad ID, by default on Android and only after Allow on iPhone

capabilities.name: App Attest
capabilities.plain: Cryptographic proof to a server that a request came from a genuine copy of the app on real Apple hardware.
capabilities.headline: Can prove its requests come from the real app on a real iPhone

capabilities.name: App Set ID
capabilities.plain: A resettable per-developer ID on Android, not for ads.
capabilities.headline: Can recognise your Android phone across one developer's apps, not for ads

capabilities.name: Autofill (app side and service side)
capabilities.plain: Lets the keyboard offer saved usernames, passwords, cards and addresses in app forms.
capabilities.headline: Can offer saved logins, cards and addresses in forms, only after you tap a suggestion

capabilities.name: Credential provider role (third party password and passkey manager)
capabilities.plain: An app registers as the person's password and passkey manager for the whole system.
capabilities.headline: Can act as your phone's password and passkey manager once you turn it on

capabilities.name: DeviceCheck two bits
capabilities.plain: Apple stores two bits per device per developer on its servers.
capabilities.headline: Can store two yes or no flags about your device on Apple's servers

capabilities.name: Request an ID or credential from a wallet (verifier)
capabilities.plain: Asks the phone's wallet for a verified age, name or license, with the person's consent.
capabilities.headline: Can ask your wallet to prove one fact, such as your age, once you approve

capabilities.name: Firebase installation ID
capabilities.plain: A random per-install ID created by the Firebase SDK.
capabilities.headline: Can recognize this one install of the app with a random ID, until it is removed

capabilities.name: Game services sign in (Play Games, Game Center)
capabilities.plain: Signs the player into the platform game account for scores and saves.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in to your game account to save progress and post scores

capabilities.name: Hardware backed keys (Keystore and Secure Enclave)
capabilities.plain: Creates cryptographic keys that never leave the phone's secure chip.
capabilities.headline: Can make secret keys that stay locked inside your phone's security chip

capabilities.name: Identifier for Vendor (IDFV)
capabilities.plain: A per-vendor iOS ID that is the same across one developer's apps.
capabilities.headline: Can recognize you across apps from the same developer on iPhone, but not other developers

capabilities.name: Passkeys in an app (create and sign in)
capabilities.plain: Creates and uses phishing resistant passkeys for sign in inside an app.
capabilities.headline: Can create and use passkeys inside the app after you approve with your device lock

capabilities.name: Play Integrity verdicts
capabilities.plain: Google returns a signed verdict on the device, app, and account integrity.
capabilities.headline: Can ask Google whether the phone and app look genuine and unmodified

capabilities.name: Sign in with Google
capabilities.plain: One tap sign in with a Google account that is already on the phone.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with a Google account already on your phone after you tap

capabilities.name: Android ID (SSAID)
capabilities.plain: A 64-bit ID per app signing key and user on Android; changes on factory reset.
capabilities.headline: Can recognize your Android phone with a long ID, separate for each app maker

capabilities.name: IDs that survive uninstall (Keychain, Block Store)
capabilities.plain: iOS Keychain items and Android Block Store data can outlive an uninstall.
capabilities.headline: Can keep a small stored ID that may come back after you delete and reinstall

capabilities.name: ID in Wallet (issue and provision)
capabilities.plain: Adds a driver's license or passport as a digital ID to the phone wallet.
capabilities.headline: Can add your driver's license or passport based ID to your phone's wallet

capabilities.name: Widevine device ID (MediaDrm)
capabilities.plain: A DRM device ID that some apps read as a stable fingerprint.
capabilities.headline: Can tell your Android phone apart using a hidden video protection ID, but not on iPhone

capabilities.name: Age range signal
capabilities.plain: Asks the OS whether the user is in an age band, without giving a birth date.
capabilities.headline: Can learn your age band, such as 13 to 15, but not your birth date

capabilities.name: App Attest and Play Integrity
capabilities.plain: Proves to a server that a request came from a genuine copy of the app on a genuine device.
capabilities.headline: Can prove its requests come from the real app on a genuine phone

capabilities.name: Sign in with Apple and Credential Manager
capabilities.plain: Account sign in that can hide the real email behind a relay address.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with Apple and hide your real email if you choose

capabilities.name: Clipboard access banner
capabilities.plain: A banner or toast tells the person that an app read the clipboard.
capabilities.headline: Can't hide a clipboard check, because you see a banner or toast when an app looks

capabilities.name: Paste permission and PasteButton
capabilities.plain: iOS asks when an app reads the clipboard from another app; a system paste button skips the prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can ask to paste from another app, and a paste button skips the prompt

capabilities.name: Developer verification
capabilities.plain: Android checks that sideloaded apps come from a registered developer.
capabilities.headline: Can only install on many Android phones if the developer is registered with Google

capabilities.name: Install unknown apps
capabilities.plain: Lets the app install other apps from APK files.
capabilities.headline: Can install other apps from files on Android, only if you allow it for that app

capabilities.name: Microsoft App Center analytics and crashes

capabilities.headline: Can send usage and crash reports to Microsoft's retired tracking service from the Android app

capabilities.name: Cedexis Radar (network measurement)
capabilities.plain: Real-user network measurement SDK found in LinkedIn Android builds.
capabilities.headline: Can maybe measure how fast your connection is, as found inside LinkedIn Android

capabilities.name: Facebook SDK (login, share, analytics)

capabilities.headline: Can use your posts and profile to train AI unless you switch the setting off

capabilities.name: LinkedIn ID verification (CLEAR, Persona)
capabilities.plain: Checks a government ID and selfie through a partner inside the app.
capabilities.headline: Can check a government ID and a selfie through a partner inside the app

capabilities.name: Data sharing with Microsoft for ads
capabilities.plain: LinkedIn shares more member data with Microsoft to personalize ads.
capabilities.headline: Can use more of your LinkedIn data for Microsoft ads, unless you switch it off

capabilities.name: People You May Know from contacts and calendar
capabilities.plain: LinkedIn uses uploaded contacts and others' uploads to suggest connections.
capabilities.headline: Can suggest you to people from their uploaded contacts, even if you never uploaded yours

capabilities.name: Qualtrics survey SDK
capabilities.plain: Survey and feedback SDK found in recent LinkedIn Android builds.
capabilities.headline: Can show survey and feedback forms inside the LinkedIn Android app, in some versions

capabilities.name: Store privacy labels
capabilities.plain: What LinkedIn tells Apple and Google it collects.
capabilities.headline: Can tell you what LinkedIn says it collects, on its store pages

capabilities.name: 24-hour clock, calendar and number formats
capabilities.plain: Reads 12 or 24 hour clock, first weekday, calendar type and number format.
capabilities.headline: Can see your 12 or 24 hour clock setting, calendar type and number style

capabilities.name: Dark mode and theme
capabilities.plain: Reads whether the system uses dark or light appearance.
capabilities.headline: Can see whether your phone is in dark or light mode

capabilities.name: Reduce motion, contrast, color inversion and bold text
capabilities.plain: Reads display accessibility toggles with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see whether Reduce Motion, high contrast, inversion or bold text is on

capabilities.name: Font size and Dynamic Type setting
capabilities.plain: Reads the system text size setting, which hints at age or low vision.
capabilities.headline: Can see your text size setting, which may hint at age or vision needs

capabilities.name: Installed and custom fonts
capabilities.plain: Lists fonts: Android reads the system font dir, iOS lists system families and installed profiles.
capabilities.headline: Can see which fonts your phone has, a small but telling device detail

capabilities.name: Active keyboards and input languages
capabilities.plain: Lists enabled keyboards: open on Android, a Required Reason API on iOS.
capabilities.headline: Can see which keyboards and input languages you turned on

capabilities.name: Language, region and locale list
capabilities.plain: Reads the person's ordered language list and region with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see your language list and region, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Screen reader and assistive services flags
capabilities.plain: Tells whether TalkBack or VoiceOver, Switch Control and similar are running.
capabilities.headline: Can tell whether TalkBack, VoiceOver or similar helpers are switched on

capabilities.name: Timezone
capabilities.plain: Reads the timezone and UTC offset with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see your timezone and its offset from UTC, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Activity recognition
capabilities.plain: Asks to detect walking, driving, cycling and step counts.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you walk, drive or cycle, and count steps, after you allow Motion

capabilities.name: Approximate location
capabilities.plain: Asks for a city-block level location instead of the exact spot.
capabilities.headline: Can see roughly where you are, in a region of a few to 20 km

capabilities.name: Background location
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read location when it is closed or not on screen.
capabilities.headline: Can follow your location when the app is closed, after you choose Always allow

capabilities.name: Location button (one time share)

capabilities.headline: Can get your location once when you tap the Share button, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Motion and fitness activity
capabilities.plain: Reads step counts and whether the person is walking, running, driving or cycling.
capabilities.headline: Can see your steps and whether you walk, run, drive or cycle, after you allow

capabilities.name: Raw accelerometer and gyroscope
capabilities.plain: Reads raw motion sensor streams with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see how your phone moves and tilts, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Precise location
capabilities.plain: Asks for the device's exact GPS position while the app is in use.
capabilities.headline: Can see your exact GPS spot while you use the app, after you allow

capabilities.name: Carrier name, MCC and MNC
capabilities.plain: Android reads carrier and country codes with no prompt; iOS now returns placeholders.
capabilities.headline: Can see your carrier name and country code on Android, not iPhone

capabilities.name: Local IP addresses and DNS servers
capabilities.plain: Reads the phone's LAN addresses and DNS servers; Android 17 adds a local network permission.
capabilities.headline: Can see your phone's home network address and DNS servers, with limits in Android 17

capabilities.name: Network type, metered and constrained flags
capabilities.plain: Reads whether the phone is on Wi-Fi, cellular or VPN, and if the connection is metered.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you are on Wi-Fi, cellular or VPN, and if data is metered

capabilities.name: System proxy settings
capabilities.plain: Reads the HTTP proxy configured on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can see if your phone sends web traffic through a proxy

capabilities.name: Public IP address
capabilities.plain: Any server the app contacts sees the public IP, which can be matched to a city.
capabilities.headline: Can't avoid showing your public address to any server it contacts, which hints at a city

capabilities.name: Cellular radio technology (4G, 5G)
capabilities.plain: Reads whether the phone is on LTE, 5G or 3G.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you are on 3G, 4G or 5G, with a prompt on Android

capabilities.name: VPN active detection
capabilities.plain: Android shows a VPN flag with no prompt; iOS offers only indirect hints.
capabilities.headline: Can see if a VPN is on, directly on Android and by guessing on iPhone

capabilities.name: Wi-Fi signal strength and link speed
capabilities.plain: Android reads signal and link speed with no prompt; iOS gives signal strength only with the Wi-Fi entitlement.
capabilities.headline: Can see Wi-Fi signal strength and speed on Android; iPhone needs special approval

capabilities.name: Nearby Wi-Fi networks scan
capabilities.plain: Android lists nearby access points with location permission and throttling; iOS has no public scan.
capabilities.headline: Can list nearby Wi-Fi networks on Android, with limits and a location prompt

capabilities.name: Join or suggest a Wi-Fi network
capabilities.plain: Adds a Wi-Fi network to the phone, usually to onboard a smart device.
capabilities.headline: Can add a Wi-Fi network to your phone, usually to set up a smart device

capabilities.name: Internet access
capabilities.plain: Lets the app use the network; granted automatically on Android.
capabilities.headline: Can use the internet, which Android grants at install and iPhone allows by default

capabilities.name: Local network access
capabilities.plain: Asks to talk to devices on the home or office network.
capabilities.headline: Can talk to devices on your home or office network, after you tap Allow

capabilities.name: Multicast networking
capabilities.plain: Sends and receives multicast and broadcast traffic on the local network.
capabilities.headline: Can send and receive shared messages to many devices on your local network

capabilities.name: Nearby Wi-Fi devices
capabilities.plain: Lets the app find and connect to nearby Wi-Fi devices without needing location.
capabilities.headline: Can find and connect to nearby Wi-Fi devices without needing your location

capabilities.name: Network state
capabilities.plain: Lets the app see whether the device is online and what kind of network.
capabilities.headline: Can see if your phone is online and what kind of network it uses

capabilities.name: Wi-Fi Aware peer discovery
capabilities.plain: Finds and talks to nearby devices directly over Wi-Fi, with no router.
capabilities.headline: Can find and talk to nearby devices directly over Wi-Fi, with no router

capabilities.name: Connected Wi-Fi name and BSSID
capabilities.plain: Reads the name and ID of the Wi-Fi network the phone is on, which gives away place.
capabilities.headline: Can see your Wi-Fi name, but only with location access and extra approval

capabilities.name: Wi-Fi state
capabilities.plain: Lets the app see Wi-Fi status; the network name needs location permission.
capabilities.headline: Can see if Wi-Fi is on, and its name only with location access

capabilities.name: Android Live Updates (promoted ongoing notifications)
capabilities.plain: Android 16's progress-style notification that sits on the lock screen and status bar chip.
capabilities.headline: Can show a live progress card on your Android lock screen, if you allow it

capabilities.name: APNs delivery: payload, priority, expiration, collapse
capabilities.plain: Apple's push channel: 4 KB payload (5 KB VoIP), priority 10 or 5, optional expiry and collapse id.
capabilities.headline: Can send alerts to an iPhone through Apple, up to 4 KB of data per message

capabilities.name: Silent (background) push
capabilities.plain: A push with no alert that wakes the app in the background; Apple asks for 2 or 3 per hour at most.
capabilities.headline: Can wake the app quietly with a push, but only a few times an hour

capabilities.name: App icon badge count
capabilities.plain: Shows an unread number on the app icon.
capabilities.headline: Can show a number on the app icon, if you allow badges

capabilities.name: Notification channels and categories
capabilities.plain: Splits alerts into types the person can silence one by one.
capabilities.headline: Can sort its alerts into types you can silence one by one

capabilities.name: Communication notifications and conversations
capabilities.plain: Shows who a message is from with their photo, tied to the system's contact graph.
capabilities.headline: Can show who a message is from, with their photo, in the alert

capabilities.name: FCM message delivery: payload, TTL, collapse
capabilities.plain: Google's push channel: 4 KB payload, up to 4 weeks held, delivered through Play services.
capabilities.headline: Can send alerts to an Android phone through Google, up to 4 KB per message

capabilities.name: FCM priority and deprioritization
capabilities.plain: High priority pushes wake a sleeping phone, but Android downgrades apps that abuse them.
capabilities.headline: Can wake a sleeping Android phone with a high priority push, but misuse gets slowed down

capabilities.name: Live Activities and Dynamic Island
capabilities.plain: Pins a live status (delivery, score, ride) to the lock screen and Dynamic Island for up to 8 hours.
capabilities.headline: Can pin live status to your iPhone lock screen for up to 8 hours

capabilities.name: Live Activity push updates and budget

capabilities.headline: Can update a Live Activity by push, but important updates count against an hourly budget

capabilities.name: Ongoing and foreground service notifications
capabilities.plain: A notification the person cannot easily swipe away that shows background work is running.
capabilities.headline: Can show a notification you cannot easily swipe away while background work runs

capabilities.name: Push token registration (FCM token, APNs device token)
capabilities.plain: Gets an address that lets a server reach this app install, even when the app is closed.
capabilities.headline: Can get an address so its server can reach your app, even when closed

capabilities.name: Rich notification media attachments

capabilities.headline: Can attach pictures, sound or video to an iPhone alert, within size limits

capabilities.name: Notification service extension and mutable content
capabilities.plain: A small helper that edits an iOS push for about 30 seconds before it is shown.
capabilities.headline: Can edit an iPhone push for about 30 seconds before you see it

capabilities.name: Notification summary, grouping and cooldown

capabilities.headline: Can't decide alone when your alerts arrive; the system groups them and holds some back

capabilities.name: Time Sensitive and DND-bypass alerts

capabilities.headline: Can mark an alert urgent so it breaks through Focus for about an hour

capabilities.name: Uninstall detection through push failures

capabilities.headline: Can find out the app was removed, but only after hours or days

capabilities.name: VoIP push (PushKit) and call-style wakeups
capabilities.plain: A special push that wakes the app for a call; iOS demands it shows a call UI right away.
capabilities.headline: Can wake the app right away for a call, if it shows a call screen

capabilities.name: Ignore battery optimization
capabilities.plain: Asks to be exempt from Doze and app standby.
capabilities.headline: Can ask to keep running in the background on Android, only if you agree

capabilities.name: Run at startup
capabilities.plain: Lets the app start in the background after the phone reboots.
capabilities.headline: Can start itself in the background after your Android phone restarts

capabilities.name: Alarms and reminders
capabilities.plain: Lets the app fire alarms at an exact time.
capabilities.headline: Can set alarms at an exact time on Android, if you allow Alarms and reminders

capabilities.name: Foreground service
capabilities.plain: Lets the app run long tasks with a visible notification.
capabilities.headline: Can run long tasks on Android with a visible notification, but only for a stated purpose

capabilities.name: Full screen intent
capabilities.plain: Lets a notification take over the screen like an incoming call or alarm.
capabilities.headline: Can take over your Android screen for a call or alarm, only if you allow it

capabilities.name: Live Updates and Live Activities
capabilities.plain: Shows a live, ongoing status on the lock screen and status bar.
capabilities.headline: Can show a live status on your lock screen, if you allow it for the app

capabilities.name: Notifications
capabilities.plain: Asks to show alerts, banners and badges from the app.
capabilities.headline: Can show alerts, banners and badges, but only after you allow it

capabilities.name: Auto-granted exact alarms
capabilities.plain: Auto-granted exact alarm access for alarm and calendar apps.
capabilities.headline: Can set exact alarms by itself on Android, if it is an alarm or calendar app

capabilities.name: Wake lock
capabilities.plain: Keeps the CPU or screen awake.
capabilities.headline: Can keep your phone's processor awake on Android, or the screen on iPhone

capabilities.name: Critical alerts
capabilities.plain: A notification that rings through Do Not Disturb, Focus and the mute switch.
capabilities.headline: Can ring through Do Not Disturb, Focus and the mute switch, if Apple approves the app

capabilities.name: Provisional notification delivery
capabilities.plain: Delivers notifications quietly without asking first, for the person to keep or turn off.
capabilities.headline: Can send quiet notifications without asking first, which you can keep or turn off

capabilities.name: Push to Talk

capabilities.headline: Can start walkie talkie voice from the background on iPhone, with microphone consent

capabilities.name: Call audio recording
capabilities.plain: Blocked: neither platform lets normal apps record the other side of a phone call.
capabilities.headline: Can't record the other side of a phone call

capabilities.name: IMEI, MEID and serial number

capabilities.headline: Can't see the phone's IMEI, MEID or serial number as a normal app

capabilities.name: Device MAC address

capabilities.headline: Can't see your phone's real hardware address; apps get a fixed placeholder

capabilities.name: Other apps' data
capabilities.plain: Each app's files and memory are sealed from other apps on both platforms.
capabilities.headline: Can't open another app's files, messages or saved logins

capabilities.name: Own phone number
capabilities.plain: Android gives it behind a runtime permission; iOS has no API.
capabilities.headline: Can't get the phone's own number on iPhone; Android allows it behind a restricted permission

capabilities.name: Other running processes

capabilities.headline: Can't list the other apps running on your phone

capabilities.name: Saved Wi-Fi networks and passwords

capabilities.headline: Can't see the Wi-Fi networks or passwords your phone has saved

capabilities.name: SIM identifiers (ICCID, IMSI)

capabilities.headline: Can't see SIM identifiers like ICCID or IMSI as a normal app

capabilities.name: Alternative app marketplaces and web distribution

capabilities.headline: Can run a tiny part of an app from a link or tag, iPhone only

capabilities.headline: Can let Siri, Shortcuts or Gemini run actions inside the app, with your confirmation

capabilities.headline: Can add quick actions to the icon menu, and offer actions to voice and automation

capabilities.headline: Can save up to 25 MB of app data to your Google account daily

capabilities.name: Block Store and credential restore

capabilities.name: Custom keyboards and input methods

capabilities.headline: Can replace the on screen keyboard, but only after you add it and approve its warning

capabilities.name: Default browser and browser engine choice

capabilities.name: Default mail, navigation, dialer and messaging apps
capabilities.plain: Changes which app opens email, maps, calls, texts and passwords.
capabilities.headline: Can open your email, maps, calls and texts, once you set it as the default

capabilities.name: iCloud backup and key value store

capabilities.headline: Can save the app's folder to iCloud and keep 1 MB of values after uninstall

capabilities.name: Keychain across uninstall
