capabilities.headline: Can keep small secrets on your iPhone that survive after you delete the app

capabilities.name: Apple notarization and app review gates
capabilities.plain: Apple scans apps outside the App Store before install in the EU and Japan.
capabilities.headline: Can install apps from outside the App Store in the EU and Japan after Apple checks

capabilities.name: Identifiers across reinstall (IDFV, App Set ID)
capabilities.plain: Vendor scoped ids stay stable across reinstalls until every app from that developer is removed.
capabilities.headline: Can recognise your phone after you reinstall, across one developer's apps

capabilities.name: Share sheet and share extensions
capabilities.plain: Receives or sends content through the system share menu.
capabilities.headline: Can send or receive content through the share menu, after you pick where it goes

capabilities.name: Sideloading and Android developer verification
capabilities.plain: Android will require every installed app's developer to be verified starting 2026.
capabilities.headline: Can install apps from outside the store on Android, but the developer must be verified

capabilities.name: System search index (Core Spotlight, AppSearch)
capabilities.plain: Puts app content into system search.
capabilities.headline: Can add its own content to your phone's search, like items, chats or notes

capabilities.name: What uninstall deletes and what survives
capabilities.plain: Uninstall wipes app storage on both systems, but some data survives in backups, the cloud or the keychain.
capabilities.headline: Can't keep most data after uninstall, though backups, cloud and keychain may restore some

capabilities.name: Home screen widgets
capabilities.plain: Small live panels on the home screen that the person adds themselves; refresh rates are capped on both systems.
capabilities.headline: Can show live info on your home screen, but only refresh a limited number of times

capabilities.name: Default contactless payment app
capabilities.plain: The person picks which wallet app answers when they tap to pay.
capabilities.headline: Can answer when you tap to pay, after you pick it as the default wallet

capabilities.name: EU DMA alternative payments, links and distribution
capabilities.plain: In the EU, apps can offer other payment providers and links to the web.
capabilities.headline: Can offer other payment providers and web links in the EU, with a clear screen first

capabilities.name: In-app purchase (StoreKit 2, Play Billing)
capabilities.plain: Sells digital goods and subscriptions through the platform store.
capabilities.headline: Can sell digital items and subscriptions, after you approve each purchase

capabilities.name: Japan MSCA payments and distribution (Dec 2025)
capabilities.plain: Japan's smartphone act lets apps use other stores, payments and links from Dec 2025.
capabilities.headline: Can offer other app stores, payment options and web links to buyers in Japan

capabilities.name: Tap to Pay (accept contactless payments on the phone)
capabilities.plain: Turns the phone into a card reader for merchants.
capabilities.headline: Can accept tap payments from cards and wallets on the phone, once approved

capabilities.name: US external links and alternative billing (post Epic rulings)
capabilities.plain: In the US, apps can link out to web checkout and may offer other billing.
capabilities.headline: Can send you to outside web checkout in the US, with fees still being settled

capabilities.name: Wallet passes (boarding passes, tickets, loyalty)
capabilities.plain: Adds tickets, loyalty cards and keys to the Wallet app.
capabilities.headline: Can add tickets, boarding passes and loyalty cards to your wallet when you tap Add

capabilities.name: Wallet payment sheet (Apple Pay, Google Pay)
capabilities.plain: Takes a card payment through the OS wallet with biometric confirm.
capabilities.headline: Can charge you through Apple Pay or Google Pay without seeing your card number

capabilities.name: Contactless payments and NFC secure element
capabilities.plain: Lets an app act as a contactless card or key. Open on Android, entitlement gated on iOS.
capabilities.headline: Can act as a contactless card or key on Android freely, but iPhone needs Apple approval

capabilities.name: Accessory pairing sheet
capabilities.plain: A system picker that pairs a Bluetooth or Wi-Fi accessory without a broad permission.
capabilities.headline: Can pair a Bluetooth or Wi-Fi accessory you pick without scanning everything nearby

capabilities.name: Biometric authentication
capabilities.plain: Lets the app ask the system to verify the user with fingerprint or face.
capabilities.headline: Can ask the phone to check your fingerprint or face, without seeing either

capabilities.name: Bluetooth advertise
capabilities.plain: Lets the app make the phone discoverable to other Bluetooth devices.
capabilities.headline: Can make the phone visible to nearby Bluetooth devices, mostly while the app is open

capabilities.name: Bluetooth connect
capabilities.plain: Lets the app talk to Bluetooth devices that are already paired.
capabilities.headline: Can talk to Bluetooth devices you already paired, after you allow Bluetooth

capabilities.name: Bluetooth scan
capabilities.plain: Lets the app search for nearby Bluetooth devices.
capabilities.headline: Can search for nearby Bluetooth devices after you tap Allow

capabilities.name: Bluetooth
capabilities.plain: Scans for, connects to and advertises as Bluetooth devices.
capabilities.headline: Can scan for, connect to and broadcast as Bluetooth devices after you tap Allow

capabilities.name: Hardware drivers (DriverKit and USB)
capabilities.plain: Runs user space drivers for hardware; on iPadOS only on M series iPads.
capabilities.headline: Can run hardware drivers only on M series iPads, with Apple approval

capabilities.name: NFC
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read or emulate NFC tags and cards.
capabilities.headline: Can scan NFC tags and cards that you hold to the phone

capabilities.name: Ultra-wideband ranging
capabilities.plain: Lets the app measure exact distance and direction to other UWB devices.
capabilities.headline: Can measure exact distance and direction to nearby UWB devices while the app is open

capabilities.name: Vibration and haptics
capabilities.plain: Lets the app vibrate the phone.
capabilities.headline: Can make the phone buzz, with no prompt and no personal data

capabilities.name: Play AccessibilityService API policy
capabilities.plain: Accessibility services see and control the screen, so Play limits them to real accessibility use.
capabilities.headline: Can see and control your screen once you turn it on in Settings

capabilities.name: Account deletion requirements
capabilities.plain: Both stores require an in-app way to delete an account and its data if the app lets you create one.
capabilities.headline: Can't keep your account forever, since apps must let you delete it in the app

capabilities.name: App Review 5.1.1 and 5.1.2 data rules
capabilities.plain: Apple's review rules: collect only needed data, say why, ask consent, and do not track without ATT.
capabilities.headline: Can't collect data or track you in ways that break App Store review

capabilities.name: ATT regulatory actions and alternatives
capabilities.plain: Competition regulators are fining Apple over ATT, and Apple has agreed to change how it works in the EU.
capabilities.headline: Can show a different tracking prompt in the EU after Apple's regulator deals

capabilities.name: Play background location policy
capabilities.plain: Apps that read location while closed must justify it to Google with a video and form.
capabilities.headline: Can follow your location while closed, only if Google approves and you pick Always

capabilities.name: Play READ_CONTACTS declaration
capabilities.plain: Google adds a Contacts permission declaration so apps use the Contact Picker when possible.
capabilities.headline: Can only access all your contacts on Android if Google approves the reason

capabilities.name: Play Families policy and Apple Kids category
capabilities.plain: Child directed apps get stricter rules: no ads tracking, no personal data to third parties, and certified SDKs.
capabilities.headline: Can't track children or share their data with ad companies in kids apps

capabilities.name: Play photo and video permissions policy
capabilities.plain: Apps may not request broad photo or video access unless it is their core purpose; the Photo Picker is the default.
capabilities.headline: Can open only the photos you pick, unless Google approves broad photo access

capabilities.name: Google Play Age Signals API
capabilities.plain: A Play API that tells an app whether a user is verified as an adult or in an age band, to help meet state laws.
capabilities.headline: Can learn if you are a verified adult, or your age range, not your birthday

capabilities.name: Google Play Data safety section
capabilities.plain: A Play Store listing section where developers declare data collected, shared, and security practices.
capabilities.headline: Can tell you what the app says it collects and shares, on its Play Store page

capabilities.name: App Store privacy nutrition labels
capabilities.plain: A label on each App Store page that lists what data the app collects and whether it is linked to you or used to track you.
capabilities.headline: Can tell you what the app says it collects, on its App Store page

capabilities.name: Privacy manifests (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy)
capabilities.plain: A file in each app and listed SDK that states what data it collects and why, checked by Apple at upload.
capabilities.headline: Can list what the app and its add on tools collect, in a file Apple checks

capabilities.name: Play QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES policy
capabilities.plain: Apps that want to list every installed app must justify it to Google.
capabilities.headline: Can see every installed app on Android only if Google approves the reason

capabilities.name: Required reason APIs
capabilities.plain: Apple lists APIs that can be used to fingerprint a device and requires the app to state an approved reason.
capabilities.headline: Can't use fingerprint prone phone details on iPhone without an approved reason

capabilities.name: SDK signatures and the Play SDK Index
capabilities.plain: Apple requires signed copies of popular SDKs, and Google publishes data practices for listed SDKs.
capabilities.headline: Can check that popular add on tools were not changed, and show what they collect

capabilities.name: Play SMS and Call Log permission policy
capabilities.plain: Apps can read SMS or call logs only if they are the default handler or qualify for a narrow exception.
capabilities.headline: Can't see your texts or call history unless it is your default texting or phone app

capabilities.name: Required Reason: active keyboards
capabilities.plain: iOS reading active input modes needs 3EC4.1 or 54BD.1.
capabilities.headline: Can list your keyboards on iPhone only for approved reasons; Android lists them freely

capabilities.name: Required Reason: system boot time
capabilities.plain: iOS uptime reads need 35F9.1, 8FFB.1 or 3D61.1.
capabilities.headline: Can check how long the phone has been on; iPhone needs an approved reason

capabilities.name: Required Reason: disk space
capabilities.plain: iOS free and total storage need 85F4.1, E174.1, 7D9E.1 or B728.1.
capabilities.headline: Can check your free storage on iPhone only with a stated reason, and freely on Android

capabilities.name: Required Reason: file timestamps
capabilities.plain: iOS file creation and modification time needs a reason code: C617.1, 3B52.1, DDA9.1 or 0A2A.1.
capabilities.headline: Can check file dates on iPhone only with a stated reason, and freely on Android

capabilities.name: Required Reason APIs and privacy manifest
capabilities.plain: Apple requires apps to declare why they use 5 fingerprint-prone API groups, in a privacy manifest file.
capabilities.headline: Can only use five fingerprint prone phone details with an approved reason on iPhone

capabilities.name: Required Reason: UserDefaults
capabilities.plain: iOS UserDefaults access needs a reason code such as CA92.1 (app only) or 1C8F.1 (app group).
capabilities.headline: Can keep its own saved settings on iPhone, but must give Apple a reason

capabilities.name: Ambient light sensor
capabilities.plain: Android reads lux with no prompt; iOS has no public ambient light API.
capabilities.headline: Can measure room light on Android, but can't on iPhone

capabilities.name: Barometer and altitude
capabilities.plain: Reads air pressure; iOS needs Motion and Fitness permission for relative altitude.
capabilities.headline: Can measure air pressure and height change, after a Motion prompt on iPhone

capabilities.name: Sensor calibration fingerprint (SensorID)
capabilities.plain: Per-device factory calibration in accelerometer and gyro data identifies a phone with no ID API.
capabilities.headline: Can maybe recognize your phone from tiny sensor flaws, with no ID or prompt

capabilities.name: Motion sensors as a side channel
capabilities.plain: Motion sensors can pick up nearby speech and typing taps.
capabilities.headline: Can maybe pick up nearby speech or typing taps from motion sensors, in research

capabilities.name: Sensor list and vendor metadata
capabilities.plain: Lists the sensors the phone has, with vendor, resolution and range.
capabilities.headline: Can list the sensors your phone has, with maker, range and precision

capabilities.name: Magnetometer and compass heading
capabilities.plain: Reads magnetic field and heading; iOS true heading uses location services.
capabilities.headline: Can use your phone's compass and magnetic field, with a location link for true north

capabilities.name: Proximity sensor
capabilities.plain: Android reads the distance; iOS gives only a near or far boolean.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if something is close to the screen, such as your ear

capabilities.name: Accessibility Service (read and control the screen)
capabilities.plain: Lets an app read other apps' screens and tap for the user.
capabilities.headline: Can see and tap other apps' screens on Android, once you turn it on

capabilities.name: Kiosk and app pinning
capabilities.plain: Locks the phone to one app.
capabilities.headline: Can lock the phone to one app when you pin it or a company allows it

capabilities.name: Device admin and Device Policy (work profile, device owner)
capabilities.plain: Lets a company app enforce policies and wipe a phone.
capabilities.headline: Can enforce rules and wipe a phone only when a company manages it

capabilities.name: Mobile device management and supervision
capabilities.plain: A company server controls the phone's settings, apps and restrictions.
capabilities.headline: Can control settings, apps and restrictions on the phone, once a company enrolls it

capabilities.name: Content filters and DNS proxy
capabilities.plain: Filters or blocks network traffic and domains system wide.
capabilities.headline: Can filter or block internet traffic and domains across the phone once you set it up

capabilities.name: Read other apps' notifications
capabilities.plain: Reads what other apps show in the notification shade.
capabilities.headline: Can see other apps' notifications only on Android after you allow it in Settings

capabilities.name: Restricted settings for sideloaded apps
capabilities.plain: Android blocks some powerful toggles for apps installed outside stores.
capabilities.headline: Can't turn on powerful settings for apps installed outside stores until you allow it

capabilities.name: App privacy report and Privacy Dashboard
capabilities.plain: A log in Settings showing which apps used sensors and which domains they contacted.
capabilities.headline: Can show you which apps used sensors, and on iPhone which domains they contacted

capabilities.name: Unused app permission reset
capabilities.plain: Automatically removes permissions from apps not opened for months.
capabilities.headline: Can remove permissions from apps you have not opened for about three months, on Android

capabilities.name: Do Not Disturb access
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read and change Do Not Disturb settings.
capabilities.headline: Can check and change Do Not Disturb on Android; iPhone shows only a yes or no

capabilities.name: Screen Time and parental controls
capabilities.plain: Limits apps and websites and reads usage summaries, with opaque identifiers on iOS.
capabilities.headline: Can limit apps and websites and see usage summaries, once you or a parent allow it

capabilities.name: Focus and Do Not Disturb status
capabilities.plain: Learns only whether the person has a Focus or Do Not Disturb mode switched on.
capabilities.headline: Can learn only whether Focus or Do Not Disturb is on, not which mode

capabilities.name: Lockdown Mode and Advanced Protection
capabilities.plain: An extreme protection mode that turns off risky features for high risk people.
capabilities.headline: Can't use many risky features when Lockdown Mode or Advanced Protection is on

capabilities.name: VPN and network extensions
capabilities.plain: Routes or filters the device's network traffic as a VPN, DNS or content filter.
capabilities.headline: Can route or filter all the phone's network traffic once you accept a VPN prompt

capabilities.name: One-time permissions
capabilities.plain: A prompt choice that grants access only until the user leaves the app.
capabilities.headline: Can use location, camera or mic only until you leave, if you pick one time access

capabilities.name: Privacy dashboard and report
capabilities.plain: A system view that shows which apps used sensitive data and when.
capabilities.headline: Can show you which apps used location, camera or mic, and when

capabilities.name: Safety Check and Safety Center
capabilities.plain: A guided reset of everything shared with other people and apps.
capabilities.headline: Can quickly shut off what you share with people and apps, with one guided reset

capabilities.name: Two denial rule
capabilities.plain: After two denials, Android stops showing the permission dialog.
capabilities.headline: Can ask for a permission only twice on Android, and once on iPhone

capabilities.name: Modify system settings
capabilities.plain: Lets the app change system settings like brightness and ringtone.
capabilities.headline: Can change brightness, ringtone and screen timeout on Android; iPhone allows only brightness

capabilities.name: Call log
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read or write the list of calls made and received.
capabilities.headline: Can see your call history on Android, only for apps Google approves

capabilities.name: Place and answer calls
capabilities.plain: Lets the app start or answer phone calls without the user pressing Dial.
capabilities.headline: Can start calls for you on Android after you allow it; iPhone asks you to confirm

capabilities.name: Phone state and numbers
capabilities.plain: Lets the app see call state, the SIM and the phone's number.
capabilities.headline: Can see call state, SIM and carrier info on Android; iPhone shows no number

capabilities.name: Read and receive SMS
capabilities.plain: Lets the app read stored texts and get a copy of incoming SMS.
capabilities.headline: Can see texts on Android only if Google approves the app, and never on iPhone

capabilities.name: Send SMS
capabilities.plain: Lets the app send text messages from the user's number.
capabilities.headline: Can send texts on Android once allowed; on iPhone you tap Send yourself

capabilities.name: Clipboard-based attribution
capabilities.plain: A web page copies an install token to the clipboard, and the app reads it on first launch.
capabilities.headline: Can check the clipboard for an install code, with a warning shown on newer phones

capabilities.name: Deferred deep links
capabilities.plain: A link that sends a new user to the right in-app screen after they install the app.
capabilities.headline: Can send you to the right screen after install, using how you reached the store

capabilities.name: Device and SDK fingerprinting
capabilities.plain: Combining small device signals (model, OS, language, fonts, sensors) into a likely-unique identity.
capabilities.headline: Can guess who you are by combining small facts about your phone, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Hashed email and phone identity graphs (UID2, RampID)
capabilities.plain: Ad firms turn a hashed email or phone into a shared ID that follows people across apps and sites.
capabilities.headline: Can match you across apps and sites using your email or phone, scrambled into an ID

capabilities.name: Sign in with Apple and Hide My Email
capabilities.plain: Apple signs the person in and can give the app a random relay email instead of the real one.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in on iPhone and give the app a random relay email instead

capabilities.name: iCloud Private Relay and in-app traffic
capabilities.plain: iCloud Private Relay hides the IP in Safari and some cleartext traffic, but not most app traffic.
capabilities.headline: Can't hide your IP in most iPhone app traffic, only in Safari and some other traffic

capabilities.name: Shared Keychain access groups and app groups
capabilities.plain: Apps from one developer team can share secrets and files; other developers cannot join.
capabilities.headline: Can share saved secrets and files between apps from the same developer on iPhone

capabilities.name: Keychain and Block Store persistence across reinstall
capabilities.plain: A stored ID that survives uninstall, so a reinstalled app recognizes the person.
capabilities.headline: Can recognize you after a reinstall using an ID that stays behind on your phone

capabilities.name: Mail Privacy Protection and Link Tracking Protection
capabilities.plain: Apple Mail preloads email images through a proxy and Safari and Mail strip known tracking parameters from links.
capabilities.headline: Can't see when you open an email in Apple Mail, and some link tags get stripped

capabilities.name: Probabilistic install matching (IP plus user agent)
capabilities.plain: An MMP guesses which ad click led to an install by matching IP, device model and OS version within a short time window.
capabilities.headline: Can guess which ad led to your install by matching your IP, phone model and timing

capabilities.name: Autoplay audio and video
capabilities.plain: Starts video or sound automatically; muted video is allowed, sound usually needs prior interaction.
capabilities.headline: Can start muted video on its own, and sound only after you have interacted

capabilities.name: Leave-page confirmation (beforeunload)
capabilities.plain: Shows a generic Leave site? dialog, only if the person interacted with the page.
capabilities.headline: Can show a generic Leave site? warning when you close or leave, after you have interacted

capabilities.name: Compression Streams
capabilities.plain: Compresses or decompresses data in the page with built-in gzip, deflate or deflate-raw.
capabilities.headline: Can squeeze or unpack data in the page with the browser's built in compression

capabilities.name: Cookie Store API
capabilities.plain: Reads and changes cookies asynchronously and gets change events, including in service workers.
capabilities.headline: Can watch and change the site's own cookies, but not hidden ones or other sites' cookies

capabilities.name: Cross-origin isolation (SharedArrayBuffer, COOP, COEP)
capabilities.plain: A site can opt into an isolated mode that unlocks SharedArrayBuffer, precise timers and Wasm threads.
capabilities.headline: Can switch on a locked down mode that unlocks fast shared memory for the page

capabilities.name: alert, confirm and prompt dialogs
capabilities.plain: Blocks the page with a modal alert, confirm or prompt box.
capabilities.headline: Can freeze the page with a pop up message box until you answer it

capabilities.name: Trigger file downloads
capabilities.plain: Saves a file to the device; repeated automatic downloads ask permission.
capabilities.headline: Can save a file to your device, but repeated automatic downloads ask first

capabilities.name: Drag and drop
capabilities.plain: Lets people drag items within or into the page, and lets the page start drags.
capabilities.headline: Can let you drag items on the page, or drop files onto it

capabilities.name: Fenced frames
capabilities.plain: Embeds content that cannot talk to or be read by the page around it.
capabilities.headline: Can embed a box of content that the page around it cannot look into

capabilities.name: Focus and window raise
capabilities.plain: Can move focus between elements; cannot pull the window to the front or steal focus from other apps.
capabilities.headline: Can move the cursor between boxes on its page, but can't pull its window forward

capabilities.name: Fullscreen
capabilities.plain: Takes over the whole screen for a page element after a click.
capabilities.headline: Can make a video or page area fill your screen, after you tap

capabilities.name: Push history entries (back button limits)
capabilities.plain: Adds fake history entries so Back does less than expected; browsers skip entries made without a click.
capabilities.headline: Can add extra Back button steps, but browsers skip steps made without a tap

capabilities.name: Navigate or redirect the tab
capabilities.plain: Sends the current tab to a different page by script, meta refresh or server redirect.
capabilities.headline: Can send your current tab to another page by itself

capabilities.name: Navigation API
capabilities.plain: Gives a single place to listen to and control same-document navigations.
capabilities.headline: Can watch and control page changes inside the app, such as when you press Back

capabilities.name: Open popup or new window
capabilities.plain: Opens a new tab or popup window, but only right after a click or tap.
capabilities.headline: Can open a new tab or window, but only right after you tap or click

capabilities.name: Background tab timer throttling
capabilities.plain: Hidden tabs get slower timers: 1 per second, then 1 per minute after 5 minutes in Chrome.
capabilities.headline: Can't keep its timers running fast once you switch to another tab

capabilities.name: Popover and modal dialog
capabilities.plain: Shows overlays on top of everything on the page using the top layer.
capabilities.headline: Can show a box over everything else on the page

capabilities.name: Open the print dialog
capabilities.plain: Opens the system print dialog for the page, no click required in most browsers.
capabilities.headline: Can open your print window, without a click in most browsers

capabilities.name: Task scheduling (postTask, yield)
capabilities.plain: Lets a page prioritize its own tasks and yield to input so it stays responsive.
capabilities.headline: Can sort its own tasks so the page stays quick when you tap

capabilities.name: Beacons and keepalive requests
capabilities.plain: Sends data after the person leaves or closes the page, with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can send data to a server as you leave or close the page

capabilities.name: Service Worker offline caching
capabilities.plain: Installs a script that caches pages and answers requests when offline.
capabilities.headline: Can save pages on your device so the site works offline

capabilities.name: Speculation Rules (prefetch and prerender)
capabilities.plain: A page can tell the browser to load and render the next page in the background.
capabilities.headline: Can tell your browser to load the likely next page before you tap

capabilities.name: Speech synthesis (text to speech)
capabilities.plain: Speaks text aloud with the device's voices; needs a prior interaction.
capabilities.headline: Can speak text out loud, after you have tapped on the page

capabilities.name: Change tab title and icon
capabilities.plain: Changes the tab title and icon at any time, including while the tab is in the background.
capabilities.headline: Can change its tab name and small icon at any time

capabilities.name: Scroll to text fragment
capabilities.plain: Highlights and scrolls to quoted text in a page when a link includes #:~:text=.
capabilities.headline: Can scroll to and highlight text on a page when you open a special link

capabilities.name: Vibrate the device
capabilities.plain: Triggers the phone's vibration motor in short pulses.
capabilities.headline: Can buzz the phone in short pulses, after you have tapped the page

capabilities.name: View Transitions
capabilities.plain: Animates between page states, including across same-origin navigations.
capabilities.headline: Can animate smoothly between two page screens on its own site

capabilities.name: Web Audio playback
capabilities.plain: Plays generated sound; the audio context stays silent until the person has interacted.
capabilities.headline: Can play and mix sound inside the page, after you have tapped

capabilities.name: Web Crypto (non-extractable keys)
capabilities.plain: Provides built-in cryptography; keys can be stored in the browser and marked non-exportable.
capabilities.headline: Can lock and unlock data inside the page, with keys it can't hand out

capabilities.name: Web Workers
capabilities.plain: Runs scripts on background threads with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can run extra code in the background while the page is open

capabilities.name: WebAssembly (threads, SIMD, memory limits)
capabilities.plain: Runs compiled code at near native speed inside the page, with up to 4 GB of memory (16 GB with memory64 in Chrome).
capabilities.headline: Can run fast compiled code inside the page, within memory limits

capabilities.name: WebCodecs (video and audio encode and decode)
capabilities.plain: Gives direct access to the browser's video and audio codecs with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can open and make video and sound files by itself inside the page

capabilities.name: WebRTC data channels (peer to peer)
capabilities.plain: Sends data directly between browsers without a server, with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can send data straight between two browsers, with no pop up

capabilities.name: WebSockets
capabilities.plain: Opens a two-way live connection to a server, with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can keep a live two way link to a server, with no pop up

capabilities.name: WebTransport
capabilities.plain: Opens low-latency streams and datagrams to an HTTP/3 server, with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can open fast two way streams to a server, with no pop up

capabilities.name: Close a window from script
capabilities.plain: Closes windows the script opened; ordinary tabs cannot be closed by script.
capabilities.headline: Can close windows it opened itself, but not your regular tabs

capabilities.name: Built in AI model download and local data
capabilities.plain: The browser downloads a Gemini Nano model and keeps prompts on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can tell that your browser downloaded a local AI model, which hints at your hardware

capabilities.name: Language Detector API
capabilities.plain: Guesses the language of text on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can guess the language of text on your device, without sending it away

capabilities.name: Prompt API (LanguageModel, Gemini Nano)
capabilities.plain: Runs a local language model in Chrome and lets a page prompt it.
capabilities.headline: Can run a small AI model on your device with text you give the page

capabilities.name: Proofreader API
capabilities.plain: Checks spelling and grammar on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can check spelling and grammar of text you typed, on your device, in Chrome testing

capabilities.name: Rewriter API
capabilities.plain: Rewrites text in a different tone or length on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can rewrite text you typed in a new tone or length, on your device, in testing

capabilities.name: Summarizer API
capabilities.plain: Summarises long text on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can summarize a long text on your device, without sending it away

capabilities.name: Translator API
capabilities.plain: Translates text on the device between languages.
capabilities.headline: Can translate text on your device between languages, without sending it away

capabilities.name: WebGPU compute
capabilities.plain: Lets a page run general GPU compute shaders.
capabilities.headline: Can use your graphics chip for heavy math, and learn what kind of chip you have

capabilities.name: WebNN (neural network API)
capabilities.plain: Runs machine learning models on the device's NPU, GPU or CPU.
capabilities.headline: Can run AI models on your device's chips, but only in Chrome and Edge testing

capabilities.name: Writer API
capabilities.plain: Writes new text from a prompt on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can draft new text from a prompt on your device, only in Chrome and Edge testing

capabilities.name: Account profile fields
capabilities.plain: What the person typed when signing up: name, email, phone, address, birthday and more.
capabilities.headline: Can keep the details you typed when signing up, such as name, email and address

capabilities.name: Apple Hide My Email relay
capabilities.plain: A random Apple address that forwards mail to the person's real inbox.
capabilities.headline: Can only see a random Apple address that forwards mail to your real inbox

capabilities.name: Cross device identity linking
capabilities.plain: A site recognises one person across phone, laptop and tablet when they sign in on each.
capabilities.headline: Can recognize you as one person across your phone, laptop and tablet when you sign in

capabilities.name: Device Bound Session Credentials
capabilities.plain: A device held key that stops stolen session cookies from working on another computer.
capabilities.headline: Can tie your sign in to this device so copied cookies stop working elsewhere

capabilities.name: Federated Credential Management (FedCM)
capabilities.plain: A browser mediated sign in that works without third party cookies or hidden redirects.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with the account you pick in a browser prompt

capabilities.name: Passkeys and WebAuthn sign in
capabilities.plain: Phishing resistant sign in with a key stored on the device or password manager.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with a passkey after your fingerprint, face or PIN

capabilities.name: Password manager and Credential Management API
capabilities.plain: Browsers and password managers fill saved logins and let a site read or store a credential.
capabilities.headline: Can fill your saved login once you pick it, and offer to save new ones

capabilities.name: Session cookies and tokens
capabilities.plain: The cookie or token that keeps a person signed in between pages.
capabilities.headline: Can keep you signed in between pages with a small ID stored in your browser

capabilities.name: Sign in with Apple
capabilities.plain: A login where Apple confirms identity and can hide the person's real email address.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with Apple and get a real or hidden email address

capabilities.name: Sign in with Google
capabilities.plain: A one click login where Google tells the site who the person is.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with Google and learn your name, email and photo

capabilities.name: Sign in with LinkedIn
capabilities.plain: A login where LinkedIn confirms the person and shares basic professional profile details.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with LinkedIn and see your basic profile details

capabilities.name: Sign in with Microsoft
capabilities.plain: A login where Microsoft Entra or a personal account tells the site who the person is.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with Microsoft and learn your name, email and employer

capabilities.name: Camera (video capture)
capabilities.plain: Asks to turn on the camera and receive live video.
capabilities.headline: Can see and record live video from your camera while the tab is open

capabilities.name: Camera pan, tilt and zoom control
capabilities.plain: Lets a site move or zoom a PTZ-capable camera.
capabilities.headline: Can move or zoom a motorized camera, once the site already has camera access

capabilities.name: Captured Surface Control (scroll and zoom the shared tab)
capabilities.plain: Lets an app scroll and zoom the tab it is capturing.
capabilities.headline: Can scroll and zoom the browser tab it is sharing, if from the same site

capabilities.name: Screen, window and tab capture
capabilities.plain: Asks to record or stream a screen, window or browser tab.
capabilities.headline: Can see the screen, window or tab you choose to share, until you stop

capabilities.name: enumerateDevices label gating
capabilities.plain: Lists camera, microphone and speaker counts; names only after permission.
capabilities.headline: Can count your cameras, mics and speakers, but names stay hidden until you allow access

capabilities.name: MediaRecorder
capabilities.plain: Records a camera, mic or screen stream to a file in the page.
capabilities.headline: Can save a camera, mic or screen stream to a file, once you allowed it

capabilities.name: Microphone (audio capture)
capabilities.plain: Asks to turn on the microphone and receive live audio.
capabilities.headline: Can hear and record live audio from your microphone while the tab is open

capabilities.name: Picture-in-Picture and automatic PiP
capabilities.plain: Pops a video into a small floating window above other apps.
capabilities.headline: Can float a video in a small window over your other apps

capabilities.name: Region Capture and Element Capture
capabilities.plain: Crops a screen capture to part of the page, no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can crop a screen share to one part of the page, with no extra prompt

capabilities.name: Audio output device selection (selectAudioOutput)
capabilities.plain: Lets a site pick which speaker or headphones play audio.
capabilities.headline: Can send sound to the speaker or headphones you pick

capabilities.name: Web Speech recognition
capabilities.plain: Turns microphone audio into text.
capabilities.headline: Can turn your spoken words into text while you speak and the tab is open

capabilities.name: HTML <usermedia> element (camera and microphone)
capabilities.plain: A browser-drawn button that asks for camera or microphone; the click is the request.
capabilities.headline: Can ask for camera or microphone through a button the browser draws itself

capabilities.name: Purchase history and loyalty data
capabilities.plain: A signed in shop knows exactly what the person bought, when, and how much they paid.
capabilities.headline: Can see what you bought, when and for how much, once you are signed in

capabilities.name: Compute Pressure
capabilities.plain: Reports how busy the device CPU is in four coarse levels.
capabilities.headline: Can tell roughly how busy your device is, only while the page is in view

capabilities.name: Browser saved address and card autofill
capabilities.plain: Chrome and Safari offer saved addresses and cards to fill checkout forms.
capabilities.headline: Can offer your saved addresses and cards to fill a form, if you pick them

capabilities.name: Autofill and autocomplete tokens
capabilities.plain: Form fields can ask the browser to fill saved name, email, phone, address and birthday.
capabilities.headline: Can ask your browser to fill saved name, email, phone and address

capabilities.name: Contact Picker
capabilities.plain: Lets a person choose contacts to share with a site; Chrome on Android only.
capabilities.headline: Can see only the contacts you pick, and only the details it asks for

capabilities.name: getInstalledRelatedApps
capabilities.plain: Lets a site check whether its own native app is installed.
capabilities.headline: Can check if its own app is installed, but not see your other apps

capabilities.name: Whole address book or call log
capabilities.plain: A site cannot read your whole contact list, call history or SMS.
capabilities.headline: Can't see your whole contact list, call history or text messages

capabilities.name: WebOTP (one time code from SMS)
capabilities.plain: Lets a page read the one time code from an SMS the person receives.
capabilities.headline: Can see one text message code meant for that site, after you allow it

capabilities.name: Ad blocker detection
capabilities.plain: Detects ad blockers via bait elements and filter-list selectors.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you use an ad blocker and roughly which filter lists

capabilities.name: Battery status
capabilities.plain: Reads charge level and charging state where the browser still offers it.
capabilities.headline: Can see your battery level and charging state in Chrome and Edge

capabilities.name: Battery Status
capabilities.plain: Battery level, charging state and time estimates, without a prompt on Chromium.
capabilities.headline: Can see your battery level and charging state, with no prompt in Chrome

capabilities.name: Browser flavor globals
capabilities.plain: Checks for window objects only certain browsers define (chrome, safari, __gCrWeb, opr).
capabilities.headline: Can tell which browser you really use, even when the label is changed

capabilities.name: Client Hints: architecture and bitness
capabilities.plain: CPU family (x86 or ARM) and 32 or 64 bit, via high-entropy Client Hints.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if your chip is Intel, AMD, or ARM, and 32 or 64 bit

capabilities.name: Client Hint: form factors
capabilities.plain: Device class list: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, XR, Automotive, EInk, Watch.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you use a desktop, phone, tablet, watch, or car screen

capabilities.name: Client Hint: device model
capabilities.plain: Android phone or tablet model name, only when the site asks.
capabilities.headline: Can see the model name of your Android phone or tablet when it asks

capabilities.name: Client Hint: platform version
capabilities.plain: Exact operating system version, via a high-entropy Client Hint.
capabilities.headline: Can tell your exact Windows or macOS version when it asks

capabilities.name: Codec support probing
capabilities.plain: canPlayType and isTypeSupported answers across dozens of codecs.
capabilities.headline: Can test which video and audio formats your browser can play

capabilities.name: Legacy cpuClass and oscpu
capabilities.plain: Old non-standard strings naming the CPU class and operating system CPU.
capabilities.headline: Can sometimes see an old CPU and OS string, mostly in Firefox

capabilities.name: CSS system colors and system fonts
capabilities.plain: Computed values of system color keywords and font names reveal OS and theme.
capabilities.headline: Can guess your OS and theme from how system colors and fonts look

capabilities.name: Approximate device RAM
capabilities.plain: RAM in gigabytes, rounded down to a power of two and capped at 8.
capabilities.headline: Can see roughly how much RAM you have, rounded and capped at 8 GB

capabilities.name: DevTools open detection
capabilities.plain: Heuristics that guess when the browser developer tools are open.
capabilities.headline: Can guess when your browser developer tools are open, but often gets it wrong

capabilities.name: Extension presence probing
capabilities.plain: Detects installed Chrome extensions by fetching their exposed files.
capabilities.headline: Can find out which Chrome extensions you have by testing known files

capabilities.name: Gamepad presence
capabilities.plain: Lists connected game controllers, but only after a button press on the controller.
capabilities.headline: Can see a game controller only after you press a button on it

capabilities.name: CPU logical core count
capabilities.plain: Number of logical processors the browser may use.
capabilities.headline: Can see how many processor threads your device has

capabilities.name: Private browsing detection
capabilities.plain: Infers whether the browser is in a private or incognito window.
capabilities.headline: Can often tell if you are in a private window, until browsers close the gaps

capabilities.name: Installed fonts via measurement
capabilities.plain: Detects which fonts are installed by measuring text width, no permission needed.
capabilities.headline: Can tell which fonts you have installed by measuring text, with no prompt

capabilities.name: Media Capabilities
capabilities.plain: Which video and audio formats decode smoothly and power-efficiently on this device.
capabilities.headline: Can ask how well your device plays each video and audio format

capabilities.name: Media device kinds and counts
capabilities.plain: Counts of cameras, microphones and speakers, without names, before any permission.
capabilities.headline: Can count your cameras, mics, and speakers without names before you allow access

capabilities.name: Legacy navigator properties (appName, appVersion, platform, vendor ...)
capabilities.plain: Frozen strings such as appName, appVersion, appCodeName, platform, product, productSub, vendor and vendorSub.
capabilities.headline: Can see old fixed labels naming your browser maker, OS family, and engine

capabilities.name: navigator.oscpu, vendor, productSub
capabilities.plain: Legacy engine strings: oscpu (Firefox), vendor, vendorSub, productSub, cpuClass.
capabilities.headline: Can see old engine labels that tell Chrome, Safari, and Firefox apart

capabilities.name: navigator.platform
capabilities.plain: Legacy string naming the OS family such as Win32, MacIntel, Linux x86_64 or iPhone.
capabilities.headline: Can see a short label for your OS family, like Win32, MacIntel, or iPhone

capabilities.name: PDF viewer enabled
capabilities.plain: Whether the browser shows PDFs inline instead of downloading them.
capabilities.headline: Can see if your browser shows PDFs inline instead of downloading them

capabilities.name: JS heap size
capabilities.plain: Chromium reports JavaScript heap size limits, which track device RAM.
capabilities.headline: Can see how much memory the page can use, which hints at your RAM class

capabilities.name: navigator.plugins and mimeTypes
capabilities.plain: List of browser plugins and MIME types; now a fixed list of 5 PDF viewers.
capabilities.headline: Can see a fixed list of 5 PDF viewers, so it no longer tells you apart

capabilities.name: Secure context and cross-origin isolation
capabilities.plain: Flags telling whether the page is HTTPS and isolated from other origins.
capabilities.headline: Can check whether the page is on HTTPS and isolated, which describes the site, not you

capabilities.name: Speech synthesis voices
capabilities.plain: Installed text-to-speech voices, which reveal OS, version and installed language packs.
capabilities.headline: Can list the speech voices on your device, which hint at your OS and languages

capabilities.name: Storage quota estimate
capabilities.plain: Reports how much storage the origin may use, which tracks total disk size.
capabilities.headline: Can see how much storage the site may use, which tracks your disk size

capabilities.name: Storage and cookie availability flags
capabilities.plain: Tests whether cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage and IndexedDB work.
capabilities.headline: Can check whether cookies and site storage work in your browser

capabilities.name: Touch support
capabilities.plain: How many simultaneous touches the screen supports and whether touch events exist.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if your screen takes touch and how many fingers at once

capabilities.name: UA Client Hints, high entropy
capabilities.plain: Detailed device and browser versions a site can request with Accept-CH or a JavaScript call.
capabilities.headline: Can see detailed device and browser versions, but only if the site asks

capabilities.name: UA Client Hints, low entropy
capabilities.plain: Browser brand list, mobile flag and OS name that Chromium sends by default.
capabilities.headline: Can see your browser brand, whether it is mobile, and your OS name

capabilities.name: User agent string
capabilities.plain: The text the browser sends naming its browser, version and operating system.
capabilities.headline: Can see your browser, version, and operating system from the text it sends

capabilities.name: User-Agent string
capabilities.plain: The browser's self-description sent on every request and readable in JavaScript.
capabilities.headline: Can see your browser brand, version, OS family, and chip family on every request

capabilities.name: Automation detection (navigator.webdriver)
capabilities.plain: Tells whether the browser is controlled by automation, plus other marker checks.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if a script or automation tool is driving your browser

capabilities.name: Automation (webdriver) flag
capabilities.plain: True when the browser is being driven by Selenium, Playwright, Puppeteer or similar.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if Selenium, Playwright, or Puppeteer is controlling the browser

capabilities.name: WebGL parameters and extensions
capabilities.plain: About 65 WebGL limits and an extension list that differ by GPU and driver.
capabilities.headline: Can measure about 65 graphics limits that point to your GPU and driver

capabilities.name: GPU via WebGL unmasked renderer
capabilities.plain: Reads the graphics card and driver name through WebGL.
capabilities.headline: Can see your graphics card and driver name through WebGL

capabilities.name: WebGPU adapter info
capabilities.plain: GPU vendor, architecture, features and limits through WebGPU.
capabilities.headline: Can see your GPU maker, design family, and graphics limits through WebGPU

capabilities.name: Color and pixel depth
capabilities.plain: Bits per pixel the screen reports; almost always 24.
capabilities.headline: Can see how many colors your screen reports, almost always 24 bit

capabilities.name: Color depth, pixel depth and pixel ratio
capabilities.plain: Reads bits per pixel and the device pixel ratio (zoom or Retina factor).
capabilities.headline: Can see your screen's color depth and how sharp or zoomed it is

capabilities.name: color-gamut
capabilities.plain: Widest color space the screen shows: sRGB, P3 or Rec2020.
capabilities.headline: Can check whether your screen shows standard, wide P3 or very wide Rec2020 colors

capabilities.name: Custom or hidden cursor
capabilities.plain: Replaces the mouse pointer with an image, or hides it, inside the page.
capabilities.headline: Can swap your mouse pointer for an image, or hide it, only inside the page

capabilities.name: Device pixel ratio and zoom
capabilities.plain: How many physical pixels per CSS pixel; also changes with browser zoom.
capabilities.headline: Can see your screen's sharpness factor, which also shifts when you zoom

capabilities.name: display-mode
capabilities.plain: How the page is shown: browser tab, standalone, fullscreen, PWA.
capabilities.headline: Can tell whether it is open in a browser tab, a home screen app or fullscreen

capabilities.name: Document Picture-in-Picture
capabilities.plain: Opens a small always-on-top window containing any HTML.
capabilities.headline: Can open a small floating window with its own content after you click

capabilities.name: dynamic-range and video-dynamic-range
capabilities.plain: Whether the screen can show HDR.
capabilities.headline: Can check whether your screen can show HDR bright and dark detail

capabilities.name: forced-colors
capabilities.plain: True when Windows High Contrast or similar forces a palette.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if Windows High Contrast or a similar mode is forcing your colors

capabilities.name: Fullscreen API
capabilities.plain: Lets a page take over the whole screen.
capabilities.headline: Can fill your whole screen after you tap, with a clear way out

capabilities.name: Embed another page in an iframe
capabilities.plain: A page can show another site inside a frame unless that site blocks framing.
capabilities.headline: Can show another site inside its own page, unless that site blocks it

capabilities.name: inverted-colors
capabilities.plain: True if the OS inverts colors (Safari Smart Invert).
capabilities.headline: Can tell if your device inverts screen colors, such as Smart Invert on iPhone

capabilities.name: Keyboard Lock
capabilities.plain: Lets a fullscreen page capture shortcut keys like Esc, Alt+Tab or Ctrl+W (Chromium only).
capabilities.headline: Can capture shortcut keys like Esc or Ctrl+W, but only in fullscreen on Chromium

capabilities.name: Screen orientation
capabilities.plain: Whether the screen is portrait or landscape and its rotation angle.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if your screen is upright or sideways, and by how many degrees

capabilities.name: Picture in Picture (video)
capabilities.plain: Pops a video into a small always-on-top window, usually after a click.
capabilities.headline: Can pop a video into a small floating window after you tap

capabilities.name: hover, pointer, any-pointer
capabilities.plain: Whether the main input is a mouse, finger or stylus and whether hover works.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you use a mouse, finger or stylus, and whether hover works

capabilities.name: prefers-color-scheme
capabilities.plain: Whether the OS or browser theme is light or dark.
capabilities.headline: Can tell whether your device theme is light or dark

capabilities.name: prefers-contrast
capabilities.plain: OS setting for higher or lower color contrast.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you asked your device for more or less contrast

capabilities.name: prefers-reduced-data
capabilities.plain: User wants less data use (data saver).
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you asked for less data use, where the browser supports it

capabilities.name: prefers-reduced-motion
capabilities.plain: OS setting to reduce animation.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you asked your device to cut down on animation

capabilities.name: prefers-reduced-transparency
capabilities.plain: OS setting to reduce translucent effects.
capabilities.headline: Can tell if you asked your device to make windows less see through

capabilities.name: Display refresh rate (measured)
capabilities.plain: Estimated by timing animation frames; 60, 90, 120 or 144 Hz.
capabilities.headline: Can estimate your screen's refresh rate by timing about one second of animation

capabilities.name: Screen frame (taskbar insets)
capabilities.plain: Offsets between full screen and usable area reveal taskbar or dock size and position.
capabilities.headline: Can tell how big your taskbar or dock is and where it sits

capabilities.name: Screen orientation
capabilities.plain: Reads portrait or landscape and angle.
capabilities.headline: Can check whether your screen is portrait or landscape and its angle

capabilities.name: Viewport meta and visual viewport
capabilities.plain: visualViewport reports pinch-zoom scale and on-screen keyboard offsets.
capabilities.headline: Can see your pinch zoom level and when the on screen keyboard pops up

capabilities.name: Screen width and height
capabilities.plain: The monitor or phone screen size in CSS pixels, plus the usable area.
capabilities.headline: Can see your screen width and height, and the usable area, in page units

capabilities.name: Scroll control and hijacking
capabilities.plain: Moves the page scroll position and can change scrolling behaviour or capture the wheel.
capabilities.headline: Can scroll its own page and change how scrolling feels, but nothing else

capabilities.name: Theme color for browser UI
capabilities.plain: Tints the browser's address bar or tab strip with a color the page picks.
capabilities.headline: Can tint your browser's address bar or tab strip with a color it picks

capabilities.name: update, scripting, monochrome
capabilities.plain: Screen refresh type, whether JS is enabled, and monochrome depth.
capabilities.headline: Can tell how your screen refreshes, if scripting is on, and if it is monochrome

capabilities.name: Screen Wake Lock
capabilities.plain: Keeps the screen from dimming or sleeping while the tab is visible; no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can keep your screen awake while the tab is open and showing

capabilities.name: Window Management (multi-screen)
capabilities.plain: Asks to see all connected monitors and place windows on them.
capabilities.headline: Can see all your connected screens and place windows on them, if you allow

capabilities.name: Move and resize own window
capabilities.plain: Moves or resizes a popup the site opened; ignored for normal tabs.
capabilities.headline: Can move or resize only a popup window it opened itself

capabilities.name: Window position and multi-screen flag
capabilities.plain: Window position on the desktop and whether more than one monitor is attached.
capabilities.headline: Can see where your browser window sits and whether you have two or more screens

capabilities.name: Window inner and outer size
capabilities.plain: Browser window and viewport dimensions, which change constantly.
capabilities.headline: Can see your browser window and visible page size, as they change

capabilities.name: Blob URLs (object URLs)
capabilities.plain: Makes a temporary URL for in-memory data or a File, usable in links, images and downloads.
capabilities.headline: Can make temporary links to data held in memory, which work only on its own site

capabilities.name: Capture attribute (camera or mic from a file input)
capabilities.plain: Opens the phone camera or microphone directly from a file input; the page gets one finished file.
capabilities.headline: Can open your camera or microphone app for one photo, video or clip

capabilities.name: File System Access: folder picker and blocked folders
capabilities.plain: Lets the person grant a whole folder for reading and writing; sensitive system folders are refused.
capabilities.headline: Can open and change files in a whole folder you pick, but not system folders

capabilities.name: Directory upload (webkitdirectory)
capabilities.plain: Lets the person pick a whole folder; the page gets every file in it with relative paths.
capabilities.headline: Can access every file inside a folder you choose, in order to upload them

capabilities.name: Dropping files and folders onto the page
capabilities.plain: Receives files and whole folders the person drags onto the page, with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can receive files or whole folders you drag onto the page

capabilities.name: File input (choose files to upload)
capabilities.plain: Opens the system file chooser; the page gets only the files the person picks.
capabilities.headline: Can open only the files you pick in the file chooser

capabilities.name: File metadata (name, size, type, modified time)
capabilities.plain: Shows name, byte size, MIME type and last modified time of any file the person shares.
capabilities.headline: Can see the name, size, type and last changed date of files you share

capabilities.name: File System Access: open and save pickers
capabilities.plain: Lets the person pick files and then read and write them in place; Chromium only.
capabilities.headline: Can open files you pick and save changes back to them, in Chrome and Edge

capabilities.name: Origin Private File System (OPFS)
capabilities.plain: Gives the page a private, fast file system inside the browser, with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can keep large private files in the browser that you cannot browse yourself

capabilities.name: Spoofing and lie detection (signals)
capabilities.plain: Checks whether language, resolution, OS or browser values were faked and whether an ad blocker is on.
capabilities.headline: Can check whether your browser settings were faked or an ad blocker is on

capabilities.name: Web MIDI (midi and midi sysex)
capabilities.plain: Asks to talk to connected music gear such as keyboards and controllers.
capabilities.headline: Can talk to your connected music gear, with a prompt for deeper control

capabilities.name: Web NFC
capabilities.plain: Asks to read or write NFC tags with your phone.
capabilities.headline: Can scan NFC tags or save to them with your phone, after you allow it

capabilities.name: TLS client certificates
capabilities.plain: A site can ask the browser to present a certificate stored on the computer.
capabilities.headline: Can ask your browser to show a certificate stored on your computer

capabilities.name: Credential Management (password and federated)
capabilities.plain: Lets a site store and fetch saved passwords through the browser.
capabilities.headline: Can fetch a saved login after you pick an account in a browser sheet

capabilities.name: Digital Credentials API (mDL and wallet IDs)
capabilities.plain: Lets a site ask for a government ID or other credential from a digital wallet.
capabilities.headline: Can ask for facts from your digital ID, only the ones you approve

capabilities.name: FedCM (Federated Credential Management)
capabilities.plain: Lets a site ask the browser to sign the person in with Google, Apple or similar without third party cookies.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with Google, Apple or similar using a browser account picker

capabilities.name: HTTP authentication (Basic, Digest, Negotiate)
capabilities.plain: A server can make the browser ask for a username and password.
capabilities.headline: Can make your browser ask for a username and password in a plain box

capabilities.name: Sign In with LinkedIn (OpenID Connect)
capabilities.plain: Lets a site sign people in with their LinkedIn account and receive basic profile data.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with LinkedIn and get your name, photo and email

capabilities.name: Private State Tokens
capabilities.plain: Lets one site share a trust signal about a visitor with another without identifying them.
capabilities.headline: Can pass a small trust badge about you between sites without naming you

capabilities.name: Storage Access API (for embedded SSO)
capabilities.plain: Lets an embedded iframe ask for its own cookies back on third party pages.
capabilities.headline: Can ask to get its own cookies back when shown inside another site

capabilities.name: WebAuthn passkey registration
capabilities.plain: Creates a passkey or security key credential for the site.
capabilities.headline: Can create a passkey or security key login for one site

capabilities.name: WebAuthn sign in (get) and conditional mediation
capabilities.plain: Signs the person in with a passkey, including autofill style suggestions.
capabilities.headline: Can sign you in with a passkey, even from the username box suggestions

capabilities.name: WebAuthn PRF and largeBlob extensions
capabilities.plain: Derives a secret from a passkey or stores a small blob on it.
capabilities.headline: Can use your passkey to make an encryption key or store a tiny note on it

capabilities.name: WebAuthn Related Origin Requests
capabilities.plain: Lets one passkey work across several of a company's domains.
capabilities.headline: Can let one passkey work across a company's own listed websites

capabilities.name: WebAuthn Signal API
capabilities.plain: Lets a site tell the passkey manager a credential is gone or its name changed.
capabilities.headline: Can tell your passkey manager that a passkey is gone or renamed

capabilities.name: Async Clipboard read
capabilities.plain: Asks to read what is on the clipboard.
capabilities.headline: Can see what you last copied, after you allow it or tap Paste

capabilities.name: Async Clipboard write
capabilities.plain: Puts text or images onto the clipboard.
capabilities.headline: Can put text or images on your clipboard when you tap a button

capabilities.name: Editable regions and spellcheck
capabilities.plain: Makes any element editable; the browser spellcheck may run on what is typed.
capabilities.headline: Can turn parts of a page into a text editor you can type in

capabilities.name: Copy and cut events (rewrite what gets copied)
capabilities.plain: Lets a page change what the person's copy or cut puts on the clipboard.
capabilities.headline: Can change what ends up on your clipboard when you copy from its page

capabilities.name: EditContext (custom text input)
capabilities.plain: Lets canvas or custom editors receive IME and keyboard text input without a hidden text box.
capabilities.headline: Can run its own text editor that still gets your keyboard and emoji input

capabilities.name: Keyboard and IME events
capabilities.plain: Sees every key pressed while the page has focus, plus IME composition text.
capabilities.headline: Can see each key you press while the page has focus

capabilities.name: Keyboard layout map
capabilities.plain: Reads which character each physical key makes, so the page can tell the keyboard layout.
capabilities.headline: Can learn which keyboard layout you use, such as QWERTY or AZERTY

capabilities.name: Keyboard Lock
capabilities.plain: Captures keys like Escape and Alt+Tab while in fullscreen.
capabilities.headline: Can capture keys like Escape and Alt+Tab while the page is full screen

capabilities.name: Keyboard Map (layout leak)
capabilities.plain: Reveals the physical-to-printed key mapping, i.e. the keyboard layout.
capabilities.headline: Can tell your keyboard layout, which hints at your country and language

capabilities.name: Local Font Access
capabilities.plain: Asks to list every font installed on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can list the fonts installed on your computer, after you allow it

capabilities.name: Paste event (read what the person pastes)
capabilities.plain: Gives the page the clipboard contents, but only when the person presses paste inside the page.
capabilities.headline: Can get what you paste, but only when you press paste on its page

capabilities.name: Gyroscope

capabilities.name: Magnetometer

capabilities.name: AbsoluteOrientationSensor and RelativeOrientationSensor
capabilities.plain: Fused device orientation as a quaternion or rotation matrix.
capabilities.headline: Can find which way your device is facing and tilted in 3D

capabilities.name: Permissions API
capabilities.plain: Lets a page ask what each permission is currently set to without prompting.
capabilities.headline: Can check whether you allowed or blocked a feature, without asking you

capabilities.headline: Can see the public internet address your connection uses

capabilities.name: DNS resolver leak test

capabilities.name: HTTP/3 and QUIC fingerprint

capabilities.headline: Can guess your country, region and city from your IP address

capabilities.name: IPv6 prefix and interface ID stability

capabilities.name: JA3 TLS client fingerprint

capabilities.headline: Can guess which browser or app you use from how your connection starts

capabilities.name: Private Access Tokens and PACT

capabilities.headline: Can check that you are probably a real device without learning who you are

capabilities.name: Referer and Origin headers

capabilities.headline: Can tell which site you came from, usually just the site name, not the page

capabilities.headline: Can look up your internet address to learn your provider and sometimes your area

capabilities.name: Sec-Fetch-* request metadata

capabilities.headline: Can tell why a request was sent, such as a click or a script

capabilities.name: VPN, proxy and Tor detection

capabilities.name: WebRTC ICE host candidates (mDNS)

capabilities.headline: Can try to find your device's home network address, but browsers now hide it

capabilities.name: WebRTC STUN public IP discovery

capabilities.headline: Can find the public internet address of your real connection, even when some VPNs hide it

capabilities.name: Network Information (downlink, rtt, effectiveType)

capabilities.headline: Can see roughly how fast and what type your connection is, in Chrome and Edge

capabilities.name: Device client hints (DPR, Viewport, Memory)

capabilities.headline: Can learn your screen density, window width, memory and light or dark mode in Chromium browsers

capabilities.name: Direct Sockets (TCP, UDP)

capabilities.headline: Can open raw network connections only inside signed, installed apps, never on normal sites

capabilities.name: Network client hints (ECT, RTT, Downlink)

capabilities.headline: Can see your rough connection speed and delay in each request, if it asks first

capabilities.name: Local Network Access (local-network)

capabilities.name: Loopback network access (loopback-network)

capabilities.headline: Can talk to programs on your own computer, only if you allow it in Chrome

capabilities.name: Network Information API

capabilities.name: Online and offline state

capabilities.headline: Can tell if your device thinks it is online, and when that changes

capabilities.name: Serial number, IMEI and device ID

capabilities.name: Exact iPhone and iPad model

capabilities.name: MAC address

capabilities.headline: Can't see your own phone number from a web page

capabilities.name: Real IP behind a VPN

capabilities.name: Saved passwords and autofill data

capabilities.name: Screen brightness
