capabilities.plain: Reads JavaScript heap sizes in Chrome.
capabilities.headline: Can see how much memory the page uses, in Chrome and Edge

capabilities.name: Display refresh rate measurement
capabilities.plain: Counts animation frames per second to find the monitor's refresh rate.
capabilities.headline: Can count frames to find your screen's refresh rate

capabilities.name: Server-Timing header
capabilities.plain: Servers send timing metrics to the page through a response header.
capabilities.headline: Can pass timing numbers from the server to page scripts

capabilities.name: High resolution timer precision
capabilities.plain: performance.now() returns a clock whose coarseness depends on browser and isolation.
capabilities.headline: Can use a clock whose sharpness shows your browser and privacy mode

capabilities.name: Scroll and touch dynamics
capabilities.plain: Records scroll speed, swipe shape and touch pressure and size.
capabilities.headline: Can track how you scroll and swipe, plus touch size and pressure

capabilities.name: Visited link (:visited) history sniffing
capabilities.plain: Used to detect which links the person had visited by styling :visited links.
capabilities.headline: Can't find which links you visited by testing link colours anymore

capabilities.name: Shape Detection: BarcodeDetector
capabilities.plain: Finds and reads barcodes and QR codes in an image or camera frame.
capabilities.headline: Can find barcodes and QR codes in a picture or camera view

capabilities.name: Compute Pressure
capabilities.plain: Reports how stressed the CPU is (nominal, fair, serious, critical).
capabilities.headline: Can see how busy your device's chip is, but not exact numbers

capabilities.name: enumerateDevices (camera, mic, speakers count)
capabilities.plain: Lists the kinds and counts of cameras, microphones and speakers (labels only after permission).
capabilities.headline: Can count your cameras, microphones and speakers, but names stay hidden until you allow

capabilities.name: EyeDropper
capabilities.plain: Lets the person pick a colour from anywhere on screen.
capabilities.headline: Can pick one color from anywhere on your screen when you click

capabilities.name: Shape Detection: FaceDetector and TextDetector
capabilities.plain: Finds faces and printed text in an image (experimental flag only).
capabilities.headline: Can find faces and printed text in a picture, but only with a special setting on

capabilities.name: Gamepad API and haptics
capabilities.plain: Reads buttons and sticks of a connected game controller; can trigger rumble.
capabilities.headline: Can see your game controller after you press a button, and make it rumble

capabilities.name: Bulk photo library and file system
capabilities.plain: A site cannot browse your photo library or disk by itself.
capabilities.headline: Can't browse your whole photo library or your files on its own

capabilities.name: Presentation API
capabilities.plain: Lets a page show itself on a second screen such as a Chromecast.
capabilities.headline: Can show itself on a second screen you choose, like a Chromecast

capabilities.name: Remote Playback
capabilities.plain: Lets a video or audio element play on a nearby cast or AirPlay device.
capabilities.headline: Can play a video or audio on a cast or AirPlay device you choose

capabilities.name: Screen Orientation lock
capabilities.plain: Forces the screen into portrait or landscape.
capabilities.headline: Can lock your screen to portrait or landscape, but only in full screen

capabilities.name: Vibration
capabilities.plain: Makes the phone buzz in a pattern.
capabilities.headline: Can buzz the phone in a pattern, after you have tapped on the page

capabilities.name: Web Bluetooth (GATT)
capabilities.plain: Lets a site connect to a nearby Bluetooth LE device the person picks.
capabilities.headline: Can connect to one nearby Bluetooth device you pick from a list

capabilities.name: Web MIDI
capabilities.plain: Lets a site send and receive MIDI messages to music gear.
capabilities.headline: Can send and get notes with music gear, after you allow it

capabilities.name: Web NFC
capabilities.plain: Lets a site read and write NFC tags when the phone touches one.
capabilities.headline: Can scan NFC tags and save to them when your phone touches one

capabilities.name: Web Serial
capabilities.plain: Lets a site open a serial port the person picks and exchange bytes with it.
capabilities.headline: Can open one serial port you pick and exchange data with it

capabilities.name: WebHID
capabilities.plain: Lets a site read and write raw reports from a keyboard, pad or other HID device the person picks.
capabilities.headline: Can talk to one keyboard, pad or other device you pick from a list

capabilities.name: WebUSB
capabilities.plain: Lets a site talk directly to a USB device the person picks.
capabilities.headline: Can talk to one USB device you pick from a list

capabilities.name: WebXR hand tracking
capabilities.plain: Reads the position of each finger joint in a headset session.
capabilities.headline: Can see where each of your fingers is inside a headset session

capabilities.name: WebXR immersive VR and AR sessions
capabilities.plain: Starts a full VR or AR session on a headset or phone.
capabilities.headline: Can start a full VR or AR session after you allow it

capabilities.name: WebXR world sensing (hit test, anchors, depth, planes, camera)
capabilities.plain: Lets an AR session see surfaces, depth and even raw camera frames of the room.
capabilities.headline: Can detect surfaces and depth in your room, and even see camera frames

capabilities.name: Do Not Track flag
capabilities.plain: Reads whether the person turned on Do Not Track.
capabilities.headline: Can see whether you turned on Do Not Track

capabilities.name: Audio fingerprint (OfflineAudioContext)
capabilities.plain: Renders a sound offline and reads tiny numeric differences.
capabilities.headline: Can make a silent test sound to tell your device apart from others

capabilities.name: AudioContext hardware properties
capabilities.plain: Reads the audio output sample rate, latency and channel count with no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can see your audio setup, such as sample rate and output channels

capabilities.name: AudioContext rendering fingerprint
capabilities.plain: Renders a silent tone through an audio graph offline and sums the output samples.
capabilities.headline: Can run a silent sound test and turn the result into a device number

capabilities.name: Canvas fingerprint
capabilities.plain: Draws text and shapes in a hidden canvas and reads back the pixels.
capabilities.headline: Can draw a hidden picture and use tiny pixel differences to tell devices apart

capabilities.name: Canvas 2D fingerprint
capabilities.plain: Draws text and shapes to a hidden canvas, then hashes the pixels the device produced.
capabilities.headline: Can turn a hidden drawing into a device number that works without cookies

capabilities.name: Composite fingerprint (FingerprintJS, CreepJS)
capabilities.plain: Combines dozens of signals into one visitor ID that survives cookie clearing.
capabilities.headline: Can combine many device traits into one visitor ID that survives cleared cookies

capabilities.name: Brave farbling
capabilities.plain: Brave adds small per-site random noise to canvas, WebGL, audio and other readouts.
capabilities.headline: Can't track you across sites by device traits when Brave adds random noise

capabilities.name: Chrome and Edge: no default fingerprint defense
capabilities.plain: Chrome and Edge do not randomize or block fingerprinting APIs by default.
capabilities.headline: Can't stop sites from using device traits to spot you in Chrome or Edge

capabilities.name: Firefox Fingerprinting Protection and RFP
capabilities.plain: Firefox randomizes canvas readback and spoofs other values in strict modes and Private Browsing.
capabilities.headline: Can't be fingerprinted as easily in Firefox strict mode or Private Browsing

capabilities.name: Safari Advanced Fingerprinting Protection
capabilities.plain: Safari limits what known fingerprinting scripts can read and perturbs canvas and audio readback.
capabilities.headline: Can't use many device traits in Safari to tell you apart

capabilities.name: Tor Browser uniformity and letterboxing
capabilities.plain: Tor Browser makes all users look the same: fixed fonts, letterboxed window, canvas prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can't tell Tor Browser users apart, since everyone looks the same

capabilities.name: CSS feature and media query probing
capabilities.plain: Tests which CSS properties, at-rules and media queries the browser understands.
capabilities.headline: Can find your browser version by testing which style features it knows

capabilities.name: DOMRect and getClientRects metrics
capabilities.plain: Measures element boxes at subpixel precision, including text, emoji and ranges.
capabilities.headline: Can measure text and emoji boxes to spot your fonts and system

capabilities.name: Emoji and glyph rendering
capabilities.plain: Renders emoji and rare Unicode characters and measures or hashes how they look.
capabilities.headline: Can draw emoji to tell your system and version apart

capabilities.name: Error message and stack formats
capabilities.plain: Triggers errors and reads their message text and stack trace format.
capabilities.headline: Can trigger small errors to learn which browser engine you really use

capabilities.name: Font enumeration by text metrics
capabilities.plain: Tests hundreds of font names by comparing text width against a fallback font.
capabilities.headline: Can test hundreds of font names to learn which fonts are on your device

capabilities.name: Installed font detection (and Flash fonts)
capabilities.plain: Measures text width to guess which fonts are installed.
capabilities.headline: Can measure text widths to guess which fonts are on your device

capabilities.name: GPU timing fingerprint (DrawnApart)
capabilities.plain: Times many identical GPU draw calls to expose per-chip speed differences.
capabilities.headline: Can time many GPU drawing jobs to tell apart even identical graphics chips

capabilities.name: Intl and locale formatting quirks
capabilities.plain: Reads Intl resolved options and formatting outputs for many locales and calendars.
capabilities.headline: Can check language, calendar and number format settings to spot your browser build

capabilities.name: JS and Web API feature detection (version pinning)
capabilities.plain: Checks which JavaScript, WebAssembly and Web APIs exist to estimate the exact browser version.
capabilities.headline: Can test which web features exist to guess your exact browser version

capabilities.name: Math function precision
capabilities.plain: Evaluates Math.tan, cosh, expm1 and similar at odd inputs and compares the exact digits.
capabilities.headline: Can run maths tests and use the last digits to tell your browser and chip apart

capabilities.name: Media codec and capability probing
capabilities.plain: Asks which audio and video codecs, containers and DRM systems the browser supports.
capabilities.headline: Can ask which video, audio and copy protection formats your device supports

capabilities.name: Plugins and MIME types
capabilities.plain: Lists installed plugins and supported MIME types.
capabilities.headline: Can list your browser plugins and file types, which now adds little

capabilities.name: speechSynthesis voice list
capabilities.plain: Lists the text-to-speech voices installed on the device.
capabilities.headline: Can list the spoken voices installed on your device

capabilities.name: SVG text metrics
capabilities.plain: Measures SVG text extents and glyph positions.
capabilities.headline: Can measure picture text sizes to learn about your fonts and system

capabilities.name: Anti-spoof and lie detection
capabilities.plain: Detects when privacy tools or anti-detect browsers have replaced browser functions.
capabilities.headline: Can tell when a privacy tool or anti detect browser changed your browser's answers

capabilities.name: WebGL renderer and parameters
capabilities.plain: Reads the graphics card name and GPU capability values.
capabilities.headline: Can see your graphics card name and its capability limits

capabilities.name: WebGL parameters and extensions
capabilities.plain: Reads the GPU vendor and model string, hardware limits and the list of supported WebGL extensions.
capabilities.headline: Can see your graphics card model, limits and which 3D features it supports

capabilities.name: WebGL render hash
capabilities.plain: Renders a fixed 3D scene with custom shaders and hashes the output pixels.
capabilities.headline: Can draw a hidden 3D scene and use the pixels to tell your device apart

capabilities.name: WebGL shader precision formats
capabilities.plain: Reads float and integer precision ranges the GPU shader units support.
capabilities.headline: Can check how precise your graphics chip maths is, to guess your chip family

capabilities.name: WebGPU adapter info
capabilities.plain: Asks the browser which GPU vendor and architecture WebGPU will run on.
capabilities.headline: Can ask which graphics maker and design your device will use for 3D work

capabilities.name: WebGPU features and limits
capabilities.plain: Reads which optional WebGPU features and numeric limits the GPU supports.
capabilities.headline: Can list which optional graphics features and limits your device supports

capabilities.name: Apple Pay and Private Click Measurement flags
capabilities.plain: Safari-only flags: Apple Pay availability and ad attribution support.
capabilities.headline: Can check if Apple Pay is set up and if you use Safari

capabilities.name: Audio base latency
capabilities.plain: AudioContext.baseLatency reveals the audio stack and hardware.
capabilities.headline: Can measure your audio delay to guess your system and audio hardware

capabilities.name: CPU architecture via float behavior
capabilities.plain: Telling ARM from x86 by how Float32 values behave in JavaScript.
capabilities.headline: Can run number tests to tell whether your chip is ARM or x86

capabilities.name: Math function precision
capabilities.plain: Tiny differences in Math.tan, acosh, sinh and others across engines and CPUs.
capabilities.headline: Can run maths tests and use the last digits to tell your browser apart

capabilities.name: Back forward cache
capabilities.plain: The browser freezes a left page whole and restores it instantly on Back, with scripts and state intact.
capabilities.headline: Can freeze this page when you leave and bring it back instantly on Back

capabilities.name: BroadcastChannel
capabilities.plain: Lets tabs and frames of the same site send messages to each other instantly.
capabilities.headline: Can send messages between open tabs and frames of the same site

capabilities.name: Cache Storage
capabilities.plain: A store of HTTP responses used by service workers to serve pages offline.
capabilities.headline: Can keep copies of pages and files so the site opens without internet

capabilities.name: First party cookies
capabilities.plain: Small name and value pairs a site stores in the browser and gets back on every request.
capabilities.headline: Can keep small notes in your browser and get them back on every visit

capabilities.name: File System Access (read and write handles)
capabilities.plain: Lets a site open files and folders and save changes back in place.
capabilities.headline: Can open files and folders you pick and save changes back in place

capabilities.name: IndexedDB
capabilities.plain: A large browser database that can hold gigabytes of structured data for one site.
capabilities.headline: Can keep gigabytes of organized data for its own site in your browser

capabilities.name: localStorage
capabilities.plain: A browser store of up to about 5 MB per site that scripts read at any time and that survives restarts.
capabilities.headline: Can keep up to about 5 MB of text notes per site, until cleared

capabilities.name: Origin Private File System
capabilities.plain: A private, fast file area per site that the person cannot browse and that counts against quota.
capabilities.headline: Can keep fast private files in the browser that count against its storage limit

capabilities.name: Storage persistence and eviction
capabilities.plain: A site can ask the browser to keep its data permanently; otherwise it can be evicted when disk is low.
capabilities.headline: Can ask the browser to keep its saved data when space runs low

capabilities.name: Persistent storage (persist)
capabilities.plain: Asks the browser not to delete this site's stored data under disk pressure.
capabilities.headline: Can ask the browser not to delete its saved data when disk space is low

capabilities.name: Incognito and private mode detection
capabilities.plain: Guesses whether the browser is in private mode using storage quota behavior.
capabilities.headline: Can guess whether you are in a private or Incognito window

capabilities.name: sessionStorage
capabilities.plain: A per tab store of up to about 5 MB that is cleared when the tab closes.
capabilities.headline: Can keep up to about 5 MB of notes for this tab until you close it

capabilities.name: SharedWorker
capabilities.plain: A background script that all tabs of a site share, so one process keeps state across them.
capabilities.headline: Can run one background script shared by all open tabs of the site

capabilities.name: Storage Access API
capabilities.plain: Lets an embedded third-party frame ask for its own cookies back.
capabilities.headline: Can ask to get its own cookies back when shown inside another site

capabilities.name: Storage feature detection (localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, openDatabase, addBehavior)
capabilities.plain: Tests which storage APIs work in this browser.
capabilities.headline: Can test which storage tools your browser lets it use

capabilities.name: Storage partitioning
capabilities.plain: Browsers key embedded storage by the top site so a tracker sees a separate store on each site.
capabilities.headline: Can't use the same embedded storage to recognize you across different sites

capabilities.name: Storage quotas and eviction
capabilities.plain: How much each site may store on the device, per browser.
capabilities.headline: Can store only what your browser allows, and may lose it when space is low

capabilities.name: Top-level storage access (requestStorageAccessFor)
capabilities.plain: Lets a top-level page request cookie access on behalf of related embedded sites.
capabilities.headline: Can ask Chrome to let related embedded sites use their cookies, if you allow

capabilities.name: window.name carry over
capabilities.plain: A string on the tab that survives page loads and was once used to carry data between sites.
capabilities.headline: Can carry a short text string in the tab from one page to the next

capabilities.name: Page Lifecycle and back/forward cache
capabilities.plain: Tells a page when it is frozen, discarded or restored from the back/forward cache.
capabilities.headline: Can tell when your tab sleeps, is discarded or returns from the Back button

capabilities.name: Reporting API (crash, CSP and deprecation reports)
capabilities.plain: Sends the browser's own error, crash and policy violation reports to a site endpoint.
capabilities.headline: Can get the browser's crash and error reports sent to the site

capabilities.name: requestAnimationFrame timing
capabilities.plain: Runs code before each screen refresh, and reveals the display's refresh rate.
capabilities.headline: Can run code before each screen refresh and learn your refresh rate

capabilities.name: Idle callbacks
capabilities.plain: Runs low priority work when the browser is idle; no prompt.
capabilities.headline: Can wait until the browser is idle to run low priority jobs

capabilities.name: Timestamp seed (tsSeed)
capabilities.plain: Records the browser's clock value when collection starts.
capabilities.headline: Can note your browser's clock when it starts collecting data

capabilities.name: User Timing marks and measures
capabilities.plain: Lets a page stamp named points in time and measure the gaps between them.
capabilities.headline: Can mark points in time and measure gaps between them inside the page

capabilities.name: APFC / DNA device fingerprint (abuse prevention features)
capabilities.plain: Collects about 48 device and browser traits, encrypts them, and attaches them to later requests.
capabilities.headline: Can collect about 48 device traits and send them in secret with later requests

capabilities.name: Conversions API (server to server events)
capabilities.plain: Advertisers send purchase and lead events straight from their servers with hashed identifiers.
capabilities.headline: Can send your purchases and sign ups to LinkedIn from a company's servers

capabilities.name: LinkedIn ad sync cookies (UserMatchHistory, AnalyticsSyncHistory, lms_ads, li_sugr, _guid)
capabilities.plain: Cookies that sync LinkedIn IDs with ad partners and match visitors by probability.
capabilities.headline: Can match your browser to ad partners' records so ads can follow you

capabilities.name: LinkedIn anti-abuse cookies (li_bapfcc, li_odapfcc, li_apfcdc, spectroscopyId, fid, fcookie)
capabilities.plain: Cookies that control and carry the fingerprint and extension scans, disclosed in LinkedIn's own table.
capabilities.headline: Can check your browser for bots and add a device fingerprint to your visit

capabilities.name: LinkedIn identity and session cookies (bcookie, bscookie, lidc, li_gc, li_mc)
capabilities.plain: Cookies that give each browser and member a stable ID on LinkedIn and on sites with its tag.
capabilities.headline: Can give your browser and account a steady ID on LinkedIn and partner sites

capabilities.name: Enhanced matching (hashed email from the browser)
capabilities.plain: The tag hashes an email address in the browser and sends the hash to LinkedIn to match a member.
capabilities.headline: Can send a scrambled version of your email to LinkedIn to match you to a member

capabilities.name: Active extension probe (AED)
capabilities.plain: Fetches a hidden file from each of thousands of known extension IDs to learn which ones are installed.
capabilities.headline: Can check which of thousands of known browser extensions you have installed

capabilities.name: HUMAN Security (PerimeterX) hidden iframe
capabilities.plain: A hidden iframe from li.protechts.net runs HUMAN's bot detection with a hash of LinkedIn's browser ID.
capabilities.headline: Can run a hidden bot check on LinkedIn pages and tie it to its browser ID

capabilities.name: LinkedIn Insight Tag (conversion pixel on other sites)
capabilities.plain: A script and pixel on advertisers' sites that reports visits and actions back to LinkedIn.
capabilities.headline: Can tell LinkedIn when you visit or act on an advertiser's site

capabilities.name: li_fat_id first party click ID
capabilities.plain: A click ID added to ad landing page URLs and saved as a first party cookie.
capabilities.headline: Can tag your visit from a LinkedIn ad click with an ID the site saves

capabilities.name: Matched Audiences (website retargeting and list upload)
capabilities.plain: Advertisers build ad audiences from site visitors or from uploaded email lists.
capabilities.headline: Can put you on an ad list after a site visit or an uploaded email

capabilities.name: Merchant Pool device fingerprint script (Microsoft DFP)
capabilities.plain: Loads mdt.js from merchantpool1.linkedin.com and runs a device fingerprint call.
capabilities.headline: Can collect device traits from a Microsoft fingerprint script on LinkedIn pages

capabilities.name: reCAPTCHA v3 Enterprise on every page
capabilities.plain: Google reCAPTCHA v3 Enterprise scores each page load without any visible challenge.
capabilities.headline: Can score every page visit for bot behavior without showing a challenge

capabilities.name: Spectroscopy DOM scan for extension traces
capabilities.plain: Walks the page's own DOM looking for chrome-extension:// strings that extensions inject.
capabilities.headline: Can look through its own page for traces that extensions leave behind

capabilities.name: LinkedIn telemetry endpoint (/li/track)
capabilities.plain: A single endpoint receives batched interaction and fingerprint events from the page.
capabilities.headline: Can send batches of your clicks and device traits from LinkedIn pages to LinkedIn

capabilities.name: Third party ID sync cookies in LinkedIn's table
capabilities.plain: Ad partner cookies (Adobe, ID5, Xandr, Yahoo, Microsoft, Google) set through LinkedIn's ad stack.
capabilities.headline: Can set partner cookies that let ad companies match you to their records

capabilities.name: Hyperlink ping attribute
capabilities.plain: A link attribute that makes the browser send a POST to extra URLs when the link is clicked.
capabilities.headline: Can tell extra web addresses when you click a link, without you noticing

capabilities.name: Ad click IDs (gclid, fbclid, msclkid and more)
capabilities.plain: Unique IDs ad platforms add to links so a later purchase can be matched to the exact ad click.
capabilities.headline: Can tag your ad click so a later purchase links back to that exact ad

capabilities.name: Attribution Reporting API (retired)
capabilities.plain: Browser measured which ad click led to a purchase. Deprecated Chrome 144; removal under way in 2026.
capabilities.headline: Can't measure which ad click led to a purchase in Chrome anymore

capabilities.name: Push, periodic sync and background fetch
capabilities.plain: Ways a site can wake its service worker after the person leaves: push messages, timed sync, long downloads.
capabilities.headline: Can wake a site's background script after you leave, through push, timed sync or downloads

capabilities.name: Bounce tracking mitigations
capabilities.plain: Browsers delete the stored data of sites the person only passed through on a redirect.
capabilities.headline: Can wipe stored data of sites you only passed through on a redirect

capabilities.name: California privacy law (CCPA, AB 566, Delete Act)
capabilities.plain: California rules that let residents opt out of sale and sharing and that require browsers to offer a signal.
capabilities.headline: Can let California residents opt out of sale and sharing, and require a browser signal

capabilities.name: CHIPS partitioned cookies
capabilities.plain: Lets an embedded service keep a cookie that is private to each top-level site where it is embedded.
capabilities.headline: Can keep a cookie for an embedded service, separate for each site it appears on

capabilities.name: Click ID and query parameter stripping
capabilities.plain: Browsers remove known tracking parameters from URLs before the site sees them, in some modes.
capabilities.headline: Can remove known tracking codes from links before the site sees them, in some modes

capabilities.name: CNAME cloaking
capabilities.plain: A tracker is served from a subdomain of the site (like metrics.site.com) that points at the tracker's servers.
capabilities.headline: Can hide a tracker as part of the site's own address so it looks first party

capabilities.name: Conversions APIs (server to server)
capabilities.plain: Advertisers send purchase and signup events from their server straight to ad platforms.
capabilities.headline: Can send your purchases and sign ups to ad platforms from the advertiser's server

capabilities.name: Cookie syncing
capabilities.plain: Ad companies swap IDs through redirects so each can recognise the same person.
capabilities.headline: Can let ad companies swap IDs so each recognizes you across sites

capabilities.name: document.referrer
capabilities.plain: Script-readable copy of the Referer, available the moment a page loads.
capabilities.headline: Can tell which page you came from the moment the page loads

capabilities.name: Hashed email as identity
capabilities.plain: A SHA-256 hash of an email lets ad platforms recognise a person without the plain email.
capabilities.headline: Can recognize you across sites by a scrambled version of your email

capabilities.name: Email open pixels
capabilities.plain: A one pixel image in an email that tells the sender when and where the message was opened.
capabilities.headline: Can tell a sender when and roughly where you opened an email

capabilities.name: Fenced Frames (being phased out)
capabilities.plain: A sandboxed ad frame that cannot talk to the page around it. Chrome is turning it into a stub in 2026.
capabilities.headline: Can't fully show an ad in a sealed frame, as Chrome makes it a stub

capabilities.name: fetch keepalive
capabilities.plain: A fetch flag that lets the request finish after the page is gone.
capabilities.headline: Can finish sending a request after you leave or close the page

capabilities.name: fetchLater
capabilities.plain: Queues a request now that the browser sends later, even if the page closes first.
capabilities.headline: Can queue a report now and have the browser send it later, even after you close

capabilities.name: Form field capture before submit
capabilities.plain: Scripts read typed or autofilled form values and can send them before the person presses submit.
capabilities.headline: Can see what you type or autofill in a form before you press submit

capabilities.name: Global Privacy Control (GPC)
capabilities.plain: A browser setting that tells every site the person opts out of sale and sharing.
capabilities.headline: Can tell every site that you opt out of sale and sharing of your data

capabilities.name: Google enhanced conversions
capabilities.plain: Google matches a hashed email or phone from a checkout to a Google account to count the sale.
capabilities.headline: Can match a scrambled email or phone from your checkout to a Google account

capabilities.name: Google tag (gtag.js)
capabilities.plain: Google's page script for analytics and ads; sets IDs like _ga and _gcl_au in the browser.
capabilities.headline: Can tell Google about your visits and actions on a site that uses the tag

capabilities.name: Global Privacy Platform string
capabilities.plain: A coded record of a person's privacy choices for US states and other regions.
capabilities.headline: Can carry your privacy choices for US states and other regions to ad partners

capabilities.name: Heatmaps and scroll depth
capabilities.plain: A script logs where people click, move and scroll so a color map of attention is built.
capabilities.headline: Can log where you click, move and scroll on a page to draw attention maps

capabilities.name: Universal IDs: UID2, ID5, RampID
capabilities.plain: Shared advertising IDs derived from login email so ad partners can match people without cookies.
capabilities.headline: Can give you a shared ad ID based on your login email, with no cookie

capabilities.name: IP address and device matching
capabilities.plain: Sites and ad vendors link visits and devices by shared IP address and basic device traits.
capabilities.headline: Can link visits and devices that share your network address and basic device traits

capabilities.name: IP Protection (discontinued)
capabilities.plain: A planned Chrome proxy to hide IP addresses from trackers. Discontinued per Oct 2025 announcement.
capabilities.headline: Can't hide your IP address from trackers in Chrome, since the plan was dropped

capabilities.name: LinkedIn Insight Tag
capabilities.plain: LinkedIn's page script that reports visits and conversions on an advertiser's site to LinkedIn.
capabilities.headline: Can tell LinkedIn about your visits and actions on a site that uses the tag

capabilities.name: Meta Pixel
capabilities.plain: Meta's page script that reports visits and actions on an advertiser's site back to Meta.
capabilities.headline: Can tell Meta about your visits and actions on a site that uses the pixel

capabilities.name: Navigational tracking
capabilities.plain: Passing IDs through link URLs or redirects when the person moves between sites.
capabilities.headline: Can pass an ID along when you move between sites by link or redirect

capabilities.name: Outbound link decoration
capabilities.plain: Adding an ID to a link's URL so the next site can read it and link the visit.
capabilities.headline: Can add an ID to a link so the next site can recognize your visit

capabilities.name: pagehide, visibilitychange and unload
capabilities.plain: Events that tell a page it is being hidden, left or closed so it can save state or send a last report.
capabilities.headline: Can tell a page when you hide or leave it, so it can send a report

capabilities.name: Private Aggregation API (removed)
capabilities.plain: Noisy aggregate reports from Protected Audience and Shared Storage. Removed in Chrome 152 (Aug 2026).
capabilities.headline: Can't send noisy ad totals from Chrome anymore, since it was removed in August 2026

capabilities.name: Private State Tokens
capabilities.plain: Anonymous tokens that carry a trust signal across sites without identifying the person.
capabilities.headline: Can carry a trust signal between sites without telling them who you are

capabilities.name: Protected Audience (FLEDGE, retired)
capabilities.plain: Browser run ad auctions for retargeting. Retirement announced Oct 2025; removal rolling out to 100% in Oct 2026.
capabilities.headline: Can't run ads in Chrome based on your interests, since the plan was retired

capabilities.name: Referer header and Referrer-Policy default
capabilities.plain: Tells the site which page the person came from, trimmed to the origin for cross-site links by default.
capabilities.headline: Can tell a site which page you came from, trimmed to the site name cross site

capabilities.name: Related Website Sets (retired)
capabilities.plain: A declared group of sites that could share cookies. Removal postponed to Chrome 152 to 153.
capabilities.headline: Can't let a group of related sites share cookies in Chrome anymore

capabilities.name: Ad network retargeting audiences
capabilities.plain: Ad pixels add a visitor to lists the site owner can later target with ads elsewhere.
capabilities.headline: Can add you to an ad list when you visit a site, so ads follow you

capabilities.name: Safari 27 IP based tracker blocking (beta)
capabilities.plain: Safari 27 beta checks the server IP of outgoing requests and can block known ad tracker ranges.
capabilities.headline: Can block requests to known ad tracker servers by their IP address in Safari 27 beta

capabilities.name: Safari 7 day script storage deletion
capabilities.plain: Safari deletes a site's script written storage after 7 days of Safari use without a visit to the site.
capabilities.headline: Can't keep script saved data in Safari after 7 days of use without a visit

capabilities.name: Search engine referral data loss
capabilities.plain: Search engines no longer pass the search keywords to the site; only the engine name arrives.
capabilities.headline: Can't see the search words you used, only the search engine's name

capabilities.name: navigator.sendBeacon
capabilities.plain: Sends a small POST that the browser delivers even while the person is leaving the page.
capabilities.headline: Can send a small report that the browser delivers even as you leave the page

capabilities.name: Server side tagging
capabilities.plain: The site sends its analytics to its own server first, which relays it to ad vendors.
capabilities.headline: Can send your activity to the site's own server first, then on to ad vendors

capabilities.name: Service worker lifetime
capabilities.plain: A background script registered by a site that persists after the tab is closed.
capabilities.headline: Can keep a background helper script for a site that stays after you close the tab

capabilities.name: Session replay
capabilities.plain: A script records page changes, mouse, scroll and typing so staff can replay a visit like a video.
capabilities.headline: Can record your clicks, scrolls and typing on a page so staff can replay it

capabilities.name: Shared Storage API (retired)
capabilities.plain: Cross-site storage whose values could only be read in a locked worker. Retired Oct 2025.
capabilities.headline: Can't store cross site data for ads in Chrome anymore, since it was retired in 2025

capabilities.name: Speculation Rules prefetch and prerender
capabilities.plain: A page can load a likely next page early, so a site may see a request before the person visits.
capabilities.headline: Can load a likely next page early, so a site may see a visit first

capabilities.name: Storage Access API
capabilities.plain: Lets an embedded frame ask to use its third-party cookies; the browser may prompt or auto-allow.
capabilities.headline: Can ask to use its own cookies when embedded in another site

capabilities.name: IAB TCF consent string
capabilities.plain: A coded record of which ad vendors and purposes the person agreed to in the EU consent banner.
capabilities.headline: Can see which ad vendors you agreed to in the EU cookie banner

capabilities.name: Third-party cookies by browser (Nov 2026)
capabilities.plain: Whether an embedded site can set and read its own cookies on other sites, which varies by browser.
capabilities.headline: Can recognise you across sites with embedded cookies, unless your browser blocks them

capabilities.name: Topics API (retired)
capabilities.plain: Chrome's interest-topic API for ads. Deprecated in Chrome 144 and being removed in 2026.
capabilities.headline: Can't pick your interests from your browsing any more; Chrome is retiring this

capabilities.name: UTM campaign parameters
capabilities.plain: Tags in the link URL that tell the site which campaign, medium and source sent the person.
capabilities.headline: Can see which ad, email, or post sent you, from tags in the link
